fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.name: Mood Cairns
fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.summary: Private, fully offline mood tracker with tags and charts. No network access.
fdroid:com.lcdcode.moodcairns.description:
A private, fully offline Android mood tracker. Log how you're feeling against your own Scales, with your own Tags, in your own time windows, on your own device. Nothing is ever uploaded - backup, if you want it, is done your own way (hint: Syncthing works well on the encrypted backups you save.).
 Features 
* Custom Scales. Five built-in scales (Happiness, Anxiety, Stress, Boredom, Pain), each numeric and color-tagged. Add your own; archive the ones you don't want.
* Custom Tags. Choose from many built-in Tags for Places, People, Activities, Moods, etc. or add your own to customize your tracking!
* Prompt windows. Define time-of-day windows (e.g. morning 08:00-12:00, evening 18:00-20:00). The app fires one notification per window per day. Tap the notification to jump straight to the log entry screen.
* History and charts. Browse past entries, see per-scale trends over time.
* In your language. Available in English, Spanish, and German. Choose the app language in Settings, independent of your phone's language.
* Encrypted on-disk storage. The mood database is encrypted at rest using SQLCipher. The key lives in memory only while the app is unlocked, and is wiped when you lock it.
* PIN + biometric lock. PIN-gated app entry, with optional biometric unlock. PIN is hashed with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) before being stored.
* Encrypted backups. Manual export writes an AES-GCM-encrypted JSON file to Documents/MoodCairns/. The encryption key is derived from a backup passphrase you choose (minimum 8 characters) with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) and a fresh per-backup salt embedded in the envelope, so any install (including a fresh one) can decrypt with the same passphrase. Backups from older versions, which were encrypted with the app PIN, still import with that PIN.
 Privacy contract 
The app declares no network permissions . Without internet, the process literally cannot open a socket, which makes phone-home impossible regardless of what any included library tries to do.
The build enforces this, so a network permission can never be silently introduced by a dependency update.
If you want backups synced off-device, point Syncthing (or any file manager that can sync a folder) at Documents/MoodCairns/.
 Contact 
The best way to get in touch for issues, feature requests, etc. is the Issues page on github.com/lcdcode/mood-cairns. I will usually respond within 3 business days. 
 Source 
Fully open source under GPL-3.0-only. Built on Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, SQLCipher, and AndroidX.

fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.name: MX3 Button Mapper
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.summary: Remap MX3 Air Mouse remote buttons on Google TV
fdroid:com.odiousapps.mx3buttonmapper.description:
MX3 Button Mapper remaps hardware buttons on MX3-style air-mouse remotes connected to Google TV devices -- buttons that send the wrong keycode, or nothing useful at all, out of the box.
 It works by combining two Android mechanisms:
 • An Accessibility Service that listens for raw scancodes system-wide and can consume (swallow) the original button press.
 • Shizuku, used to inject a replacement keycode or press sequence in place of the original one. Shizuku grants this using the same shell-level privileges 'adb shell input keyevent' already has, so no root is required. If Shizuku isn't connected but the device is rooted, the app falls back to injecting keys via 'su' instead, and so will ask your root manager for superuser access.
 Supported mapping types (a ready-made default mapping set is built in, so there is nothing to configure per button):
 • Remap a button to a different keycode (e.g. a stray Page Up/Page Down button remapped to proper Channel Up/Channel Down).
 • Fire the same keycode several times in one press (e.g. a single button that sends five D-pad presses to jump through a list).
 • Remap a button differently depending on which app is in the foreground (e.g. Channel Up/Down inside the TV app, a single Page Up/Page Down inside Kodi, and a burst of D-pad presses to jump through lists everywhere else).
 • Launch an app directly from a button press, while holding the same button still sends its normal long-press (e.g. tapping Home opens MX3 Launcher, holding it long-presses Home).
 In-app settings:
 • TV brand (TCL or Blaupunkt), since these TVs expect different keycodes for the remote's TV button and use different live-TV apps.
 • Optional key-press logging for troubleshooting, off by default.
 • App language, with the interface translated into around 100 languages.
 The app also sets itself up via Shizuku: once you agree to the in-app disclosure, it enables its own Accessibility Service for you, so there is no need to dig through Settings -> Accessibility by hand, it can launch your chosen launcher on startup, and on TCL TVs it re-grants the auto-start permission that TCL's firmware otherwise removes, so the mapper keeps working after a reboot.
 Note: some of the default mappings launch specific third-party apps for convenience (e.g. jumping straight to a launcher, a video app or a browser).
 Accessibility Service API use:
 This app uses the Accessibility Service API for its core function. The service:
 • Receives hardware key events from your remote so it can replace specific buttons with a different key, a burst of key presses, or an app launch. Buttons that aren't mapped pass through untouched.
 • Receives window-change events only to learn the package name of the app on screen, so a button can behave differently inside the TV app.
 It does not read screen content, text or passwords. No key presses or other data are collected, stored (unless you turn on the optional troubleshooting logs, which stay on the device) or shared -- the app has no internet access. The service is only turned on after you agree to an in-app disclosure, and you can turn it off at any time in Settings -> Accessibility.

fdroid:com.soumikshah.investmenttracker.description:
Plutus will help you to track all your investments in one place. We're not portfolio tracker, we won't show you daily ups and downs. We help you keep track of money moving out of your account into different types of investment.
 This app is not a budget management tool, we're not here to manage your day to day spending. This application is here to track all the investment you make. So for example you have invested money in stocks, etfs, bonds, retirement fund, high yield savings account, Fixed deposits, gold bar in your locker or just some money in your savings account. This app will allow you to list all this investments and categorize it for you into different categories/sector of investment. 
 This application will allow you to record what type of application/service you used to invest your money (For example you use couple of brokers to manage your stock portfolio, this application will allow you to list through which website/app had you invested your money. So when you open this app, it should be easier for you to notice which app to check for particular investment) And best part is it will calculate the amount invested in each category and show you a graph showing percentage of investment done in all various categories. So consider this application as your one step way to see all the money that you invest in all the places.
 Ofcourse you can do all this using Microsoft Excel as well. But we're not competing with Excel. We're here to give you an alternative way to check your finances. If you prefer to use excel, use that. But make sure your excel file is password protected and with you at all times. Because this application has fingerprint authentication and is installed on your phone on all times. So you just need to take out your phone and will be able to check your investments. (I personally don't like using excel sheet and haven't seen any of my friends commit themselve to use excel sheet to manage their finances for long time. That's the reason I decided to create this application, and as there is an alternative with excel I decided to make it opensource and free. So if you don't like excel to manage your finances, you can jump on to this application.) 
 I've also created a widget for this application. So you can just glimpse over your total invested amount on the homescreen itself. Yeah it's not safe to show this amount on the homescreen but I developed this feature just in case, any of us need any push to continue their job/business. Seeing that total invested amount on the home screen can motivate you to just give that little extra. If you don't feel it's safe to show the amount there, don't use the widget. But I gave that option just in case anyone wants to use it. And you can even place this widget on the different homescreen. So unless you swipe to it, no body else will even know it's there.
 Once you've added your investment data, you can share the data you inserted using Export data option in settings tab. You'll be able to share your data as an excel file.
 Just to be clear, this application is not a portfolio tracker. There are plenty of applications that do that already. We're here to track money going out of your bank account into different type of investment. Consider it an easy way to check how much money you've invested over the years and where. 
 Plutus doesn't use internet connection, so you can be sure that data you insert in this application is not shared with anyone (unless you share it from the settings menu). It's just for you to see. So you can be sure that we can't track your investment data, nor can we sell anything to anyone.

fdroid:com.xprs.app.name: XPRS
fdroid:com.xprs.app.summary: Off-grid messenger over the internet, Reticulum and a Bluetooth mesh
fdroid:com.xprs.app.description:
XPRS is a messenger and app launcher that works off the grid. It talks over the internet, over a Reticulum overlay, and straight over Bluetooth LE, and it stitches those together so a message or a file gets to the other side over whatever path happens to be up. If there is no internet, it falls back to a Bluetooth street mesh and long range radio. If there is internet, it uses it.
There are no accounts, no phone number and no server in the middle. Your identity is a key the device makes itself.
 What it does 
 Many transports at once. A message can go out over the internet, over Bluetooth LE, or over Reticulum, and whichever copy arrives first wins.
 It keeps working with no internet. A Bluetooth street mesh passes messages from phone to phone with nothing in between, and cheap LoRa stations push that reach out over kilometres.
 Store and forward. A message for somebody who is away is carried by the stations in between and delivered when they come back.
 Chat. One-to-one conversations, closed groups and a local room, with pictures and files.
 Social. Posts, replies and follows, spread over the same transports.
 Torrents and shared folders. Files move peer to peer, from whoever has them.
 Wapps. Small WebAssembly apps that draw through one shared native interface and use the host's transports: chat, social, mail, a media player, a file browser and more. You can install others, or write your own in the built-in editor.
 Network use 
A fresh install connects to a few public Reticulum hubs, which you can change or switch off in Settings. Maps (OpenStreetMap), torrents, and pictures you send to somebody on another network reach the internet only when you use them. NOSTR and I2P are off unless you turn them on.
XPRS is free software under the BSD 3-Clause licence.

fdroid:dev.mage.age.name: Mage
fdroid:dev.mage.age.summary: Android GUI for age file encryption, built on kage.
fdroid:dev.mage.age.description:
Mage is an Android GUI for age file encryption, built on kage (a Kotlin/JVM implementation of the age protocol). "Mage" is short for Mobile age. Mage is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by the age project.
Encrypt or decrypt files to age recipients or passphrases, including armor, multi-recipient, and encrypt-to-self. SSH keys (ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa) work as recipients and identities alongside native age keys, and can be mixed on one file.
Identities are sealed in the Android Keystore (AES-256-GCM, StrongBox where available) behind biometric or device-credential authentication. Recipients get a small address book with QR encode/scan for sharing a public key.
Batch mode encrypts or decrypts more than one file at a time into a folder. Your identity vault can be exported and re-imported as an encrypted backup, so it isn't stuck on one device.
Mage hooks into the system where it makes sense: share-sheet targets, a .age file-manager association, launcher shortcuts, and a Quick Settings tile.
Mage does not implement its own cryptography — that is kage's job. It is not a general-purpose file manager or password manager, and it does not support the age-plugin mechanism, which relies on binaries on $PATH and does not work on Android.
Mage requests no network permission and makes no network connections.

apple-macos:6781590712.name: FlatNote
apple-macos:6781590712.description:
FlatNote is a markdown notes app for people who want their writing to stay plain, portable, and theirs. It runs on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, and your notes sync across all of them through your own iCloud, or stay in a folder you choose.
Type markdown and watch it format as you go. Headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, links, quotes, bullet lists, and tappable checkboxes all render while you write. The raw symbols stay out of your way and reappear only on the line you are editing, so you always know exactly what you typed.
WHAT YOU GET
- Live formatting. See the result as you type, with a one minute reference note included.
- Photos in your notes. Paste an image or attach one; it is saved next to the note as an ordinary file, not in a database.
- Folders, pins, and sorting. Organize notes into real directories and keep the ones you use on top.
- Real checkboxes. Tap to check things off, right in the note.
- Find in a note. Search the open note and jump between highlighted matches.
- Quick formatting. A formatting bar above the keyboard on iPhone and iPad, and standard shortcuts on Mac.
- Find your notes fast. Search the whole library by title or content.
YOUR WORDS BELONG TO YOU
- Every note is a plain .md file. No proprietary format, no lock-in, readable in any app, on any device, years from now.
- Your notes live in your iCloud and sync across your iPhone, iPad, and Mac automatically, signed in with your Apple ID. No separate account to make.
- Export carries everything. Share any note as markdown, with its pictures included, or export your whole library as one zip of ordinary files. The files are also right there in the Files app on iOS and Finder on Mac.
- Delete is honest. Deleted notes go to Trash, where they can be recovered.
QUIET BY DESIGN
- No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Nothing about you leaves your devices and your iCloud.
- Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, in light and dark.
FlatNote keeps the format simple so you can keep your thinking clear.

apple-macos:6472865291.name: ZSA Keymapp
apple-macos:6472865291.description:
Keymapp is a tool for keyboards made by ZSA Technology Labs, such as the Moonlander, the Voyager, and the ErgoDox EZ. It allows you to view your ZSA keyboard's layout right on your screen, in real-time. When you switch a layer, Keymapp's display updates to show the keys active on this layer.
Keymapp also has handy shortcuts for configuring your keyboard, flashing a new layout, and accessing our rich suite of Live Training modes online.
The Heatmap view shows you the most-used keys in each of your layers, as you work. This helps you develop awareness, avoid straining weaker fingers, and fine-tune your layout over time so that it uses your strongest fingers for maximum comfort.
Keymapp's window can be made small, and can be kept always-on-top so you can use it as an overlay in the corner of your screen. Alternatively, it can work as a regular window and be as large as you want it.

apple-macos:6753737815.name: Plate Pro: Food Cost & Recipes
apple-macos:6753737815.description:
Know your true plate cost, on your Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Plate Pro is the native Apple app for food costing. Change one supplier price and every recipe, sub-recipe and menu re-costs itself, instantly. No spreadsheets to maintain. No browser tab to babysit. No account required.
THE COST CASCADE
Ingredients feed your recipes. Recipes feed your menus. When an ingredient price changes, Plate Pro flows that change through everything it touches, so your food cost % and gross profit are always live and accurate. It is the one job a spreadsheet never gets right.
MENU ENGINEERING
See every dish plotted by popularity and profit: Stars, Plowhorses, Puzzles and Dogs, so you know what to promote, reprice or cut. Build menus from your recipes and watch the margin update live.
WORK WITH AN AI ASSISTANT
Connect Claude to Plate Pro on your Mac and ask about your numbers in plain language. The built-in assistant can read your suppliers, ingredients, recipes, costs, events, to-dos, notes and waste reports, and create or edit them for you, over a private local connection. Great for processing invoices and updating supplier prices automatically. (macOS)
BUILT FOR THE MAC, AND YOUR POCKET
A real desktop app for back-office work: fast, full-screen, keyboard-quick. Plus iPhone and iPad for costing on the line or at the supplier. Everything syncs over iCloud, and it all works offline.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Cost recipes and nested sub-recipes with a live cost cascade
• Engineer your menus by popularity and profit
• Track supplier prices with full history and % change
• See food cost %, gross profit and suggested price on every recipe
• Log wastage with reasons and cost
• Keep ingredient reference data: units, conversions, allergens and par levels
• Plan ahead with a built-in planner, to-dos and notes
• Import ingredient prices by CSV
• Print recipe books, plating sheets and forms
• Run multiple businesses from one app
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No tracking. The developer collects no data. Your recipes and numbers stay on your device and in your private iCloud. The AI assistant is optional and runs over a local connection you control.
START FREE, OR SUBSCRIBE
Start free and cost your first recipes, with no trial clock. Unlock unlimited ingredients, recipes and suppliers, plus multi-business and recipe cost history, with a subscription. Or buy Plate Pro once and own it for life.
Built by hospitality people. Available in 30 languages (new translations, machine-assisted and still being refined; tell us via support if a phrase reads oddly).
Know your plate cost. Protect your margin. Get Plate Pro.
Support: https://platepro.app/support/
Privacy Policy: https://platepro.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://platepro.app/terms/

fedora-packages:tre/agrep.name: agrep
fedora-packages:tre/agrep.description: The agrep tool is similar to the commonly used grep utility, but agrep can be used to search for approximate matches. The agrep tool searches text input for lines (or records separated by strings matching arbitrary regexps) that contain an approximate, or fuzzy, match to a specified regexp, and prints the matching lines. Limits can be set on how many errors of each kind are allowed, or only the best matching lines can be output. Unlike other agrep implementations, TRE agrep allows full POSIX regexps of any length, any number of errors, and non-uniform costs.

fedora-packages:bsdiff/bsdiff.name: bsdiff
fedora-packages:bsdiff/bsdiff.description: bsdiff and bspatch are tools for building and applying patches to binary files. By using suffix sorting (specifically, Larsson and Sadakane's qsufsort) and taking advantage of how executable files change, bsdiff routinely produces binary patches 50-80% smaller than those produced by Xdelta, and 15% smaller than those produced by .RTPatch.

fedora-packages:bsf/bsf.name: bsf
fedora-packages:bsf/bsf.description: Bean Scripting Framework (BSF) is a set of Java classes which provides scripting language support within Java applications, and access to Java objects and methods from scripting languages. BSF allows one to write JSPs in languages other than Java while providing access to the Java class library. In addition, BSF permits any Java application to be implemented in part (or dynamically extended) by a language that is embedded within it. This is achieved by providing an API that permits calling scripting language engines from within Java, as well as an object registry that exposes Java objects to these scripting language engines. BSF supports several scripting languages currently: * Javascript (using Rhino ECMAScript, from the Mozilla project) * Python (using either Jython or JPython) * Tcl (using Jacl) * NetRexx (an extension of the IBM REXX scripting language in Java) * XSLT Stylesheets (as a component of Apache XML project's Xalan and Xerces) In addition, the following languages are supported with their own BSF engines: * Java (using BeanShell, from the BeanShell project) * JRuby * JudoScript

fedora-packages:dieharder/dieharder-libs.summary: A library of random number generator tests and timing routines
fedora-packages:dieharder/dieharder-libs.description: libdieharder is the core library of dieharder designed to be "the last suite of random number testers you'll ever wear". It can test any of its many pre-built and library linked generators (basically all of those in the Gnu Scientific Library plus a number of others from various sources) or a potentially random data-set in either an ASCII-formatted or raw (presumed 32 bit unsigned int) binary file. It is fairly straightforward to wrap new software generators for testing, or to add hardware generators that have a software interface for testing, and the file input method permits pretty much any software or hardware RNG to be tested using libdieharder calls. libdieharder has as a design goal the full encapsulation in an extensible shell of basically all the random number tests: George Marsaglia's "Diehard" battery of tests, STS (v1.6) from NIST FIPS, Knuth's tests, and more. Check the documentation for complete list.

fedora-packages:moby-engine/docker-cli.name: docker-cli

This means they can run anywhere, from your laptop to the largest EC2 compute instance and everything in between — and they do not require you to use a particular language, framework or packaging system. fedora-packages:InsightToolkit/InsightTo.description: ITK is an open-source software toolkit for performing registration and segmentation. Segmentation is the process of identifying and classifying data found in a digitally sampled representation. Typically the sampled representation is an image acquired from such medical instrumentation as CT or MRI scanners. Registration is the task of aligning or developing correspondences between data. For example, in the medical environment, a CT scan may be aligned with a MRI scan in order to combine the information contained in both. ITK is implemented in C++ and its implementation style is referred to as generic programming (i.e.,using templated code). Such C++ templating means that the code is highly efficient, and that many software problems are discovered at compile-time, rather than at run-time during program execution.

fedora-packages:labwc/labwc.name: labwc
fedora-packages:labwc/labwc.description: Labwc stands for Lab Wayland Compositor, where lab can mean any of the following: * lightweight and *box-inspired * sense of experimentation and treading new ground * inspired by BunsenLabs and ArchLabs * your favorite pet Labwc is a wlroots-based window-stacking compositor for Wayland, inspired by Openbox. It is light-weight and independent with a focus on simply stacking windows well and rendering some window decorations. It takes a no-bling/frills approach and says no to features such as animations. It relies on clients for panels, screenshots, wallpapers and so on to create a full desktop environment. Labwc tries to stay in keeping with wlroots and sway in terms of general approach and coding style. Labwc has no reliance on any particular Desktop Environment, Desktop Shell or session. fedora-packages:lammps/lammps-headers.name: lammps-headers

LAMMPS has potentials for soft materials (biomolecules, polymers) and solid-state materials (metals, semiconductors) and coarse-grained or mesoscopic systems. It can be used to model atoms or, more generically, as a parallel particle simulator at the atomic, meso, or continuum scale. LAMMPS runs on single processors or in parallel using message-passing techniques and a spatial-decomposition of the simulation domain. The code is designed to be easy to modify or extend with new functionality. This package contains development headers for LAMMPS.

firefox-addons:2965364.name: QSS eID
firefox-addons:2965364.summary: Use your electronic identification card for secure authentication and digital signing.
firefox-addons:2965364.description:
Use your electronic identification card for secure authentication and digital signing.
QSS eID is an eIDAS-compliant web signing extension that connects your electronic identification card to your web browser, enabling secure authentication and legally binding digital signatures on supported websites.
It supports certified electronic identity and digital certificate issuers in Bosnia and Herzegovina and across the European Union, without vendor lock-in.
What it does
• Securely authenticates users to government portals, banks, and online services using an electronic ID card
• Digitally signs documents and transactions using an electronic signature
• Works with websites that support eID-based authentication
Why install it
• No passwords – your ID card is your credential
• Legally valid digital signatures recognized across the EU
• Secure communication between your browser and smart card reader
Digital Sovereignty & Compliance
• Private keys never leave the user’s electronic ID card or secure device
• No certificates, identities, or credentials are stored or managed by QSS eID
• QSS eID does not act as a certificate authority or identity provider
• Identity management remains with certified trust service providers
Designed for compliance with eIDAS, national digital identity frameworks, and cross-border EU interoperability.
Privacy
• No personal data is collected, stored, or tracked
• No analytics, telemetry, or user activity monitoring
• No access to PINs or private cryptographic material
• All cryptographic operations are performed locally on the user’s device
Fully aligned with GDPR requirements.
Requirements
• A supported electronic ID card or qualified digital certificate
• A compatible smart card reader
• The QSS eID native application installed on your computer

firefox-addons:2981878.name: DevScope - Developer Diagnostics
firefox-addons:2981878.summary: Inspect DOM, CSS, performance, security, accessibility, SEO, network and storage in one dockable developer panel.
firefox-addons:2981878.description:
DevScope is a professional browser development toolkit for on-demand inspection and diagnostics of the active webpage.
Analyze page structure, CSS, performance, network activity, security headers, accessibility, SEO, storage, runtime behavior, and detected frameworks without switching between scattered tools.
 🧩 DOM AND ELEMENT INSPECTION 
• Analyze DOM depth, complexity, duplicate IDs, detached nodes, inline styles, and semantic structure
• Select elements directly on the page with highlight overlays and breadcrumb navigation
• Review actionable hints for common structural anti-patterns
 🎨 CSS INSPECTION AND LIVE EDITING 
• View computed styles, box model details, and the properties that actually apply
• Detect specificity conflicts and possible layout issues
• Edit styles live, see changes immediately, and reset individual properties
 ⚡ PERFORMANCE AND CORE WEB VITALS 
• Review Core Web Vitals, paint timing, resource timing, and long tasks
• Inspect JavaScript execution signals and resource usage by type
• Identify slow assets and likely performance bottlenecks
 🌐 NETWORK, STORAGE AND RUNTIME 
• Group network requests by type and status and inspect timing details
• Review LocalStorage, SessionStorage, cookies, IndexedDB, and Cache API data
• Inspect runtime errors, console messages, event listeners, timers, and script activity
 🔐 SECURITY AND ACCESSIBILITY 
• Validate HTTPS, mixed content, CSP, HSTS, Permissions-Policy, and X-Frame-Options
• Run WCAG-oriented checks for ARIA, contrast, landmarks, labels, and missing alternative text
• Use clear findings and recommendations to prioritize fixes
 🔎 SEO AND FRAMEWORK DETECTION 
• Check meta tags, Open Graph, canonical URLs, structured data, heading hierarchy, and indexability

bluejetty:00061871:ios.name: Yellow Cab Co
bluejetty:00061871:ios.summary:
Capitol & Yellow Cab Companies are the leading providers of Taxi services in Des Moines, Iowa. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Yellow Cab Co. application.
Key Feature
bluejetty:00061871:ios.description:
Capitol & Yellow Cab Companies are the leading providers of Taxi services in Des Moines, Iowa. We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Yellow Cab Co. application.
Key Features of the Yellow Cab Co. application include:
• Book a reservation in as few as 3 clicks
• Get a fare estimate by entering both pickup and destination addresses
• Receive a confirmation number for your reservation immediately on booking
• Receive notifications including vehicle number once your reservation has been dispatched
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favorite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Select an address from your list of telephone contacts
• Specify the number of passengers, vehicle type and preferred payment method
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Capitol & Yellow Cab Companies with the push of a button
To begin using the Yellow Cab Co. application today:
• Download the free app
• Create an account (Email, Name, Phone # and Password)
• Validate your account (via the confirmation email you receive)
• Login to the app (Email & Password)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip (reservations can be immediate or for a future time/date)
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Yellow Cab Co. application retains a history of your previous reservations (up to 30 days) for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favorite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed the booking process.
You can also customize your orders by selecting the number of passengers, preferred vehicle type, and preferred method of payment. These preferences can be saved to your account profile for future bookings.
At Capitol & Yellow Cab Companies, your comfort and safety are our top priorities! Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Yellow Cab Co. application.
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Yellow Cab Co. application in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00021506:ios.description:
Transforming your dream home into reality is easier than ever with our Home Design Planner app. Whether you're a homeowner, designer, or design enthusiast, this app equips you with the tools needed to craft stunning, functional spaces. Design everything from floor plans and layouts to furniture, decor, and accessories with a vast, evolving catalog of design elements.
Our user-friendly interface allows you to customize every aspect of your home design, from the floor plan and layout to the furniture, decor, and accessories.
Experiment with different styles, textures, and colors while using the drag-and-drop feature to move items and adjust sizes for a perfect fit. Visualize your space in 3D and fine-tune every detail to suit your needs. Whether it’s a full-scale renovation or a room refresh, this planner is perfect for you.
Additionally, Magical Floor Planner offers CAD drawing features and integrates with apps like Planner 5D, Magic Plan, and Floor Plan Creator. You can generate detailed floor plans, personalize decor, and explore endless design combinations—all in one place.
Looking to design your dream home or renovate your existing space? The Enchanted Design Floor Planner is here to help! With a touch of magic, this app allows you to easily create and visualize your floor plan in 2D or 3D, decor, and even landscaping to bring your vision to life. Whether you're a homeowner, a professional designer, or just love to play with design ideas, this app is perfect for you. Try it now and start creating your dream space!
1. Create detailed 3D floor plans for any home.
2. Select and personalize furniture, accessories, decor, and more from an ever-evolving catalog.
3. Experiment with hundreds of textures and colors in various combinations based on your color palette.
4. Move items around the room with ease using the drag and drop feature.
5. Adjust the size of any item to fit your space perfectly.
6. Compatible with Magic Plan, Planner 5D, and other professional planning tools.
Creator Create home floor plan and interior designs for your rooms, with magic plan whether online or offline, using the application.
Magical Floor Planner | Designer can be used without an active subscription with a limited interior design catalog and without an ability to customize furniture. Premium features can be enabled with a Monthly subscription for $2.99 or Yearly subscription for $24.99 (prices vary by region)
Payment for your subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed/turned-off at the iTunes account settings.Price for subscription may vary by location.
Download today and start planning your dream space!

• Shop online for 4G mobiles & MBB devices
• Access Entertainment including Online TV, Theatre & and Games
• Fill out a range of Feedback surveys catered to your needs
• Customer support channels e.g. Facebook, Twitter and Live Chat 24/7
• Video tutorials, FAQs and Zong Helpline

bluejetty:00017633:ios.description:
Just enough bank, right in your pocket. Our app is a Good Design Award – Gold Winner, 2025.
Open an account in minutes and get access to award-winning everyday banking that keeps things simple. The Bankwest App is built for how you bank, with tools to help you spend securely, manage your money, find things faster and get help when you need it. 
Built for how you bank. 
- View recent transactions across your accounts at a glance 
- Set savings goals and track your progress 
- See your balance in another currency 
- Add your card to your digital wallet and spend instantly. 
Spend securely. 
- Create single or multi-use virtual cards and keep your regular card details safe 
- Manage payment limits, PayTo agreements and payment history 
- Lock, replace or activate your card, and change your card PIN 
- Get notifications of unusual activity to help stay safe from scams and fraud. 
Manage your money. 
- Keep track of your subscriptions and upcoming payments within a single view 
- See your net balance, next repayment date and key account details for your home loan or credit card 
- Track how much interest you’ve saved with offsets 
- Search property values to help stay across the market. 
Customise your banking. 
- Nickname accounts so they’re easier to recognise 
- Reorder accounts on your app home screen 
- Search payments, features, transactions and support articles in seconds 
- Message us in the app anytime and get notified when we reply.

This means that if you do have a loss resulting from an unauthorised transaction in Bankwest Online Banking (including the Bankwest App), we may be able to reimburse you the full amount of any funds lost.

bluejetty:00061149:ios.description:
Al Quran - القرآن الكريم
آيات : القرآن الكريم : مشروع المصحف الإلكتروني بجامعة الملك سعود.
.Ayat : Al Quran : KSU-Electronic Mosshaf project
المميزات | Features :
عرض نسخة مصورة من المصحف الشريف.
Viewing scanned(soft) copy of real printed Mosshaf.
الإختيار بين مصحف المدينة المنورة أو مصحف التجويد الملون أو المصحف برواية ورش عن نافع.
Providing copy of Mosshaf Al-Madina, copy of Mosshaf Al-Tajweed (colored according to Tajweed rules) and copy of Mosshaf Warsh (Rewayat Warsh An-Nafei').
تلاوة للقرآن الكريم بصوت العديد من مشاهير القراء - منها تلاوتان برواية ورش عن نافع.
Holy Quran recitations by many famous reciters (two of them are by Rewayat Warsh an-Nafei').
إمكانية تكرار تلاوة الآية أكثر من مرة مع تحديد فاصل زمني.
Repeating each Aya as many times as desired with time interval in between.
إمكانية البحث في آيات القرآن الكريم.
Search through Holy Quran text.
إمكانية الإنتقال المباشر بين سور وأجزاء وصفحات المصحف الشريف.
Direct browsing the Mosshaf by Sura/Aya(Chapter/Verse) , Juz(Part) or Page number.
خمسة تفاسير باللغة العربية (السعدي وابن كثير والقرطبي والطبري والبغوي).
Five Arabic Tafsir(Commentary) "Al-Saa'di, Ibn-Katheer, Al-Baghawy, Al-Qortoby and Al-Tabary".
ترجمة نصية (مقروءة) لمعاني القرآن لأكثر من 20 لغة.
Text Translation of the Holy Quran meanings for more than 20 languages.
ترجمة صوتية (مسموعة) للغة الإنجليزية والأوردية.
Voice Translation of the Holy Quran meanings for two languages (English and Urdu).
ربط تزامني بين الآية التي يتم تلاوتها ومكانها في المصحف وترجمة معانيها.
Sync between recitaion and Aya position in the Page (highlighting Aya while recited).
ربط تلاوة الآية بالترجمة الصوتية (ترديد الترجمة الصوتية بعد تلاوة الآية).
Sync between recitaion and voice translation (repeat the translation after the recitation).
واجهة البرنامج متوفرة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.
Program Interface in both Arabic and English.
نسخة حية : live preview : http://quran.ksu.edu.sa

bluejetty:00062408:ios.description:
Speak a new language - don't just study it. Lingocard turns vocabulary into real conversation: learn words with smart flashcards, then use them live with native speakers who are ready to talk right now.
Trusted by 100,000+ learners and 1,000+ teachers in 180+ countries. 67 languages. 2,000,000+ ready-made flashcards.
WHY LINGOCARD WORKS
- Learn 30 new words a day: AI spaced repetition shows each word at the exact moment you're about to forget it, so vocabulary moves into long-term memory with the fewest reviews.
- Speak from day one: smart AI search finds your perfect practice partner in seconds - matched by native language, level, and interests. No awkward searching, no dead-end chats.
- Real friendships, real fluency: message, send voice notes, and jump on audio or video calls without leaving the app. Practice partners here often become friends for life.
- Learn hands-free: turn any word set into audio and listen while you drive, cook, or work out.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP
- Speaking practice with real people: built-in chat with audio and video calls
- Smart AI search that finds the best practice partners for you
- A worldwide community where practice turns into friendship
- 2,000,000+ flashcards with images and native-speaker audio
- Frequency dictionaries: the 10,000 most-used words in each of 67 languages
- Thematic sets: travel, business, idioms, and real-life slang
- Create your own cards with photos, or import texts and listen to them
- Daily goals, streaks, and progress charts that keep you motivated
- Cloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web
FOR TEACHERS AND SCHOOLS
Create study sets on the web, assign them to students, and track everyone's progress from one dashboard. Your students get premium learning tools at no extra cost.
LEARN ANY OF 67 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, and many more - in any combination with your native language.
Every day you wait, someone else is having the conversation you want to have. Start now: your first dictionary takes two minutes, and your first real conversation is closer than you think.
Optional Premium subscription unlocks the full library and all dictionaries. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.

- Learn 30 new words a day: AI spaced repetition shows each word at the exact moment you're about to forget it, so vocabulary moves into long-term memory with the fewest reviews.
- Speak from day one: smart AI search finds your perfect practice partner in seconds - matched by native language, level, and interests. No awkward searching, no dead-end chats.
- Real friendships, real fluency: message, send voice notes, and jump on audio or video calls without leaving the app. Practice partners here often become friends for life.
- Learn hands-free: turn any word set into audio and listen while you drive, cook, or work out.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP

- Speaking practice with real people: built-in chat with audio and video calls
- Smart AI search that finds the best practice partners for you
- A worldwide community where practice turns into friendship
- 2,000,000+ flashcards with images and native-speaker audio
- Frequency dictionaries: the 10,000 most-used words in each of 67 languages
- Thematic sets: travel, business, idioms, and real-life slang

- Daily goals, streaks, and progress charts that keep you motivated
- Cloud sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web

FOR TEACHERS AND SCHOOLS

Create study sets on the web, assign them to students, and track everyone's progress from one dashboard. Your students get premium learning tools at no extra cost.

LEARN ANY OF 67 LANGUAGES

English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Arabic, Russian, Turkish, Vietnamese, and many more - in any combination with your native language.

Every day you wait, someone else is having the conversation you want to have. Start now: your first dictionary takes two minutes, and your first real conversation is closer than you think.

bluejetty:00060667:ios.summary:
English is the world's most widely spoken language. Of the approximately 1.5 billion people who speak English, less than 400 million use it as a first language. 
NEW: 5 LANGUAGES IN ONE APP
Learn English — or switch to French, Spanish, Ger
bluejetty:00060667:ios.description:
English is the world's most widely spoken language. Of the approximately 1.5 billion people who speak English, less than 400 million use it as a first language. 
NEW: 5 LANGUAGES IN ONE APP
Learn English — or switch to French, Spanish, German or Japanese at any time in Profile.
• French, Spanish and German: 1,300+ picture words in 61 topics with native audio, the same 40+ games, alphabet tracing and smart review
• Japanese: picture words plus hiragana and katakana tracing
• English audio is built in. Another language downloads its audio once (about 10 MB), then works offline
This English learning app is very useful for beginners and those who need to improve English vocabulary, listening and speaking skills. You will be able to learn English with hundreds of words with eye-catching pictures and American standard pronunciation. It's very easy to use with simple, intuitive and powerful UI.
This app is abundant in subjects used in daily situations. Playing mini English language games in the app also helps you easily remember vocabulary and pronunciation. Let’s learn and speak English with your friends with a lot of fun.
Main Features of "Lingo Speak: Learn English ABC":
- ABC Lessons - Learn Alphabet: help you learn all English letters from A to Z;
- Vocabulary Course: learn to easily remember daily words step-by-step with well-organized lessons and many vocabulary games;
- Dictionary with images and pronunciation;
- Interesting educational games: Choose The Right Picture, Choose The Right Word, Listening Game, Picture Match, Match The Halves, Writing;
- Leaderboard with top rank users.
- Multi-language support: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Dutch, Swedish, Arabic, Chinese, Czech, Hindi, Indonesian, Malay, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Thai, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Hebrew, Bengali, Ukrainian, Hungarian.
Vocabulary Subjects:
Colors ,Animals, Insects, Alphabet, Numbers, Shapes, Fruits, Food, Body Parts, Transport, Clothes, Sports, Vegetables, Verbs, Occupations, Appliances, Emotions, School, Places, Kitchen, Weather, Nature, Bathroom, Living room, Flowers, Country Flags, Musical Instruments, Family, Ancient Egypt, Ancient Greece, Summer Time, Daily Routines, Healthy Breakfast, Famous Landmarks, and more.
Happy Learning :)

bluejetty:00041179:ios.description:
TimeCalc is a powerful yet simple time calculator for everyday use — 
add and subtract hours, track work durations, calculate future dates, and find exact age in seconds.
TIME CALCULATOR
Add, subtract multiple time values in sequence. 
Instant results, calculation history saved.
Examples:
2h 35m + 3h 45m = 6h 20m
12h 20m − 4.5h = 7h 50m
4h 52m × 3 = 14h 36m
1h ÷ 20m = 3
Convert between time units:
456m = 7h 36m = 7.6h
TIME BETWEEN (DURATION)
Enter any start and end time to calculate the exact duration. 
Organize into separate categories. 
Export PDF reports (Premium).
Examples:
11:20 AM → 12:40 PM = 1h 20m
01:30 AM → 02:30 PM = 13h
Today 02:00 → Tomorrow 02:30 = 24h 30m
DATE CALCULATOR (ADD & SUBTRACT)
From any starting date, add or subtract years/months/weeks/days/hours/minutes to get the resulting date. 
Calendar-accurate arithmetic — adding 1 month to Jan 31 gives the correct last day of February.
Example:
Today 17:32 + (1d 2h) = Tomorrow 19:32
AGE CALCULATOR
Calculate exact age in years, months, and days from a birth date. 
Save multiple birthdays to track.
---
KEY FEATURES
• Automatic light & dark mode
• Supports both 12h and 24h formats
• Multi-language support
• No account, no cloud — 100% local data
• Privacy-first — your data never leaves your device
---
PREMIUM
Upgrade to Premium to unlock the full experience:
• Remove all ads
• Unlimited Time Between categories
• Export reports to PDF
• Advanced time unit customization
Subscription plans: Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly, or Lifetime.
---
Perfect for tracking work hours, calculating durations, and managing time efficiently.
Thank you for using TimeCalc!

bluejetty:00024045:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
Embark on an emotional first-person adventure where you control the story — and affect the outcome — with your real-life blinks. 
Dive into a world of memories and experience a soul’s journey into the afterlife as your whole life flashes before your eyes.
It all begins after you die. You're aboard the ship of a mysterious man tasked with shepherding souls to the afterlife. To help you pass on, he must learn the story of your life. Then he sends you back to relive your most important moments.
The game uses your device's camera to fully immerse you in the story. Control the flow of the narrative with your real-life eyes – blinking through precious memories of family, first love and the birth of an artistic career. Dare to look deeper and delve into your most repressed memories, where a heartbreaking truth awaits.
Combining an innovative blink-interaction mechanic with a charming world and fully voice-acted story, Before Your Eyes is a deeply emotional and relatable journey — one that explores the impossible expectations we place on ourselves and the regrets we carry with us.

Colmédica Medicina Prepagada

bluejetty:00043141:ios.description:
Colmédica Medicina Prepagada 
Gracias a nuestra App Colmédica para teléfonos inteligentes y tabletas, usted tiene la posibilidad de acceder a aquella información de nuestros servicios que con mayor frecuencia y urgencia suele requerir, de manera concreta e inmediata. 
Funcionalidades de video para Autorizaciones médicas y Servicio de Orientación Médica - SOM por video llamada. 
A la hora que usted nos necesite, en la funcionalidad SOM por video llamada, un profesional de la salud estará atento y le brindará información sobre:
•Manejo de la situación de salud en su casa u oficina. 
•Institución hospitalaria más cercana de acuerdo con su ubicación geográfica. 
•Envío de médico domiciliario o ambulancia en caso de requerirse. 
Además, usted cuenta con la posibilidad de ingresar desde su dispositivo móvil y/o tableta y acceder a las siguientes funcionalidades:
•Directorio médico, a través de la cual puede consultar nuestra amplia red de profesionales médicos e instituciones tanto clínicas como diagnósticas y los Centros Médicos Colmédica. Esta funcionalidad le permite realizar de manera ágil, oportuna y detallada búsquedas por tipo de plan, ciudad, Centros Médicos Colmédica, especialidad y profesionales médicos adscritos a la red.
•Oficina virtual, en esta sección puede encontrar información sobre certificaciones, última factura, oficinas así como de los Autoservicios Colmédica.
•Favoritos, la cual permite que el usuario personalice su directorio médico haciendo un listado de los médicos y Centros Médicos Colmédica que frecuenta, ahorrándole tiempo a la hora de programar sus citas y la organización de sus fórmulas médicas, pues se tienen los datos de su preferencia, agrupados en un solo lugar.
•Solicitar citas en los Centros Médicos Colmédica y Centros Odontológicos Colmédica de forma electrónica, además de poder realizar el pago de las UPD´s en línea. Además, tiene la posibilidad de consultar la ubicación y horario de las Ópticas Colmédica. 
•Acceso rápido a las líneas de atención telefónica de Asistencia Colmédica y el SOM (Servicio de Orientación Médica). 
•Autorizaciones Médicas, por medio de la cual puede solicitar sus autorizaciones médicas y además consultar el estado de las mismas. 
•Convenios, allí puede encontrar toda la información sobre beneficios y descuentos de nuestros aliados.
•Revista Vivir Bien, donde puede consultar las últimas 9 ediciones y así disfrutar en cualquier momento la lectura de artículos desarrollados para su bienestar.
•Profesionales de salud, donde puede encontrar las funcionalidades de consultar información, consultar pagos, asistencia colmédica, solicitar papelería, autorizaciones médicas, y simulador pila.
Porque en Colmédica Medicina Prepagada continuamos innovando para su bienestar.

bluejetty:00027074:ios.description:
Keep control of your news reading with Reeder Classic, RSS reader and read later client in one app, now with support for iCloud syncing.
FEEDS
Sync all your feeds and articles with iCloud. Reeder Classic comes with a built-in RSS/Feeds service which will keep everything in sync on all your devices. Of course, this is optional. You can still just use one of the many third-party services supported by Reeder or just RSS (without sync).
READ LATER
This is Reeder's built-in read later service which stores all your data securely in iCloud. A sharing extension allows you to add links from outside of Reeder.
BIONIC READING
A higher dimension of reading. With Bionic Reading you read texts with more focus, awareness, and sustainability. Read more about Bionic Reading at bionic-reading.com.
WIDGETS
View most recent articles, configurable to only show items from feeds, folders, searches (for services that support searches) or tags (for read later services).
MARK AS READ ON SCROLL
With version 5, Reeder finally supports marking items as read while scrolling. Off by default, this can be enabled on a per-account basis.
READER VIEW
Enter Reader View (for feed items and read later links that support this) for a clutter-free reading experience directly in Reeder's article viewer. You can enable "Automatic Reader View" on a per-feed basis to always load items of a feed with Reader View.
SUPPORTED THIRD-PARTY SERVICES
Feedbin, Feedly, FeedHQ, NewsBlur, The Old Reader, Inoreader, BazQux Reader, FreshRSS, Instapaper and Pocket.

bluejetty:00029490:ios.description:
Meet Fix, an easy-to-use tone generator with a wide frequency range and built-in sounds. Easily control speaker output, repel pests, and enjoy engaging wave visualizations.
Key Features:
*** - Frequency Selection: Explore a broad frequency range from 0 to 20,000 hertz to find the ideal tone for any situation.
*** - Built-In Sounds: Enjoy a variety of preloaded sounds to enhance your audio experience.
*** - Speaker Control: Effortlessly switch audio output between your device's top and bottom speakers for optimal listening.
*** - Targeted Frequencies: Use ready-made solutions designed to scare off mosquitoes, dogs, and cockroaches with targeted frequencies.
*** - Engaging Visualizations: Enjoy captivating wave visualizations that correspond with your selected frequencies.
Fix is the ultimate companion for audio enthusiasts and anyone seeking a flexible and powerful tone generator.
Upgrade to Premium
Unlock exclusive features with the Premium version:
- Unlock all sound models.
- Unlimited Presets.
- No Ads.
Subscription Details:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.

- Weekly: $4.99
- 3 Months: $9.99

Auto Renewable Subscription
# Subscription options
We have the following subscription periods in our game:
1. Weekly Diamond Membership offers weekly subscription for $4.99 after 3-day free trial.
2. Monthly Diamond Membership offers monthly subscription for $11.99.
3. Yearly Diamond Membership offers yearly subscription for $79.99. 
# End of trial and subscription renewal
- This price is established for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user''s Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
# Canceling trial or subscription
- You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039 . When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. When your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements included in Subscription option.
# If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at help@superboxgo.com
Privacy Policy : http://superbox.kr/privacypolicy_en.php

bluejetty:00034845:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00034845:ios.description:
HOW TO USE NUTRINAUT:
Nutrinaut works best when connected to a wearable (Apple Watch, Garmin, smart rings, and more) - but you can also use it without one
- Answer a few quick lifestyle questions to personalize your baseline
- Check your daily Strain, Recovery, and Sleep insights *
- Follow simple guidance on whether to push today or take it easier *
- Log optional Tags (life events like coffee, late meal, fatigue, stress, good mood) to unlock deeper insights over time *
Nutrinaut helps you understand how your body is responding to training and life - so you can make better decisions each day. Built for active people who want clarity, Nutrinaut turns your health signals into simple, actionable guidance: when to push, when to recover, and how to improve sleep and stress.
DAILY STRAIN AND RECOVERY GUIDANCE
Know when your body is ready to perform - and when it’s not. Nutrinaut analyzes your recent load and recovery signals to provide a clear daily read on intensity. You’ll get simple guidance like whether today is best for a hard session, a moderate workout, or an easy recovery day.
DEEP SLEEP INSIGHTS
Sleep is your biggest performance lever. Nutrinaut breaks down your sleep in a way that’s easy to understand, highlighting what matters most and how it impacts your next day. Track trends, spot issues early, and build better sleep habits with practical guidance.
STRESS AND READINESS SIGNALS
Training isn’t the only stress your body deals with. Nutrinaut helps you see how overall stress patterns may affect readiness, recovery, and sleep quality - and points you toward adjustments that can reduce burnout risk over time.
FOOD PHOTO LOGGING (OPTIONAL)
Nutrition supports performance and recovery. If you want it, Nutrinaut also lets you snap a photo of your meal to get a quick nutritional breakdown, making it easier to stay consistent without turning your day into spreadsheets.
* Premium features require a paid subscription. This includes (where available) strain/recovery/sleep guidance, deeper analysis and advice, and premium logging features such as taking photos of food for nutritional breakdown, recording workouts, tracking sports supplements, and getting calories from voice recording.
Key Features:
- Strain and Recovery: Daily signals and guidance for training intensity.
- Sleep Analysis: Clear breakdowns and practical sleep improvement insights.
- Stress Insights: Understand patterns that may impact readiness and recovery.
- Food Photo Tracking: Optional meal snapshots with nutritional breakdown.
- Voice Logging: Log meals and workouts with natural language.

listings.description:
HOW TO USE NUTRINAUT:

Nutrinaut works best when connected to a wearable (Apple Watch, Garmin, smart rings, and more) - but you can also use it without one

- Answer a few quick lifestyle questions to personalize your baseline

- Check your daily Strain, Recovery, and Sleep insights *

- Follow simple guidance on whether to push today or take it easier *

- Log optional Tags (life events like coffee, late meal, fatigue, stress, good mood) to unlock deeper insights over time *

Nutrinaut helps you understand how your body is responding to training and life - so you can make better decisions each day. Built for active people who want clarity, Nutrinaut turns your health signals into simple, actionable guidance: when to push, when to recover, and how to improve sleep and stress.

DAILY STRAIN AND RECOVERY GUIDANCE
Know when your body is ready to perform - and when it’s not. Nutrinaut analyzes your recent load and recovery signals to provide a clear daily read on intensity. You’ll get simple guidance like whether today is best for a hard session, a moderate workout, or an easy recovery day.

DEEP SLEEP INSIGHTS
Sleep is your biggest performance lever. Nutrinaut breaks down your sleep in a way that’s easy to understand, highlighting what matters most and how it impacts your next day. Track trends, spot issues early, and build better sleep habits with practical guidance.

STRESS AND READINESS SIGNALS
Training isn’t the only stress your body deals with. Nutrinaut helps you see how overall stress patterns may affect readiness, recovery, and sleep quality - and points you toward adjustments that can reduce burnout risk over time.

FOOD PHOTO LOGGING (OPTIONAL)
Nutrition supports performance and recovery. If you want it, Nutrinaut also lets you snap a photo of your meal to get a quick nutritional breakdown, making it easier to stay consistent without turning your day into spreadsheets.

* Premium features require a paid subscription. This includes (where available) strain/recovery/sleep guidance, deeper analysis and advice, and premium logging features such as taking photos of food for nutritional breakdown, recording workouts, tracking sports supplements, and getting calories from voice recording.

Key Features:

- Strain and Recovery: Daily signals and guidance for training intensity.

- Sleep Analysis: Clear breakdowns and practical sleep improvement insights.

- Stress Insights: Understand patterns that may impact readiness and recovery.

- Food Photo Tracking: Optional meal snapshots with nutritional breakdown.

- Voice Logging: Log meals and workouts with natural language.

- Clean, Fast UI: Designed for quick check-ins, not endless manual entry.

NOTE: We do not provide medical advice. All recommendations should be considered suggestions. Be sure to consult a professional and do your own research before making decisions related to your health.

bluejetty:00025516:ios.description:
Plan your dream wedding day with BoBo Leah! There are so many things to do! We want to pick the most gorgeous wedding dress, choose a perfect wedding location and select a flawless wedding cake pattern, to name a few. This bridal themed play house game is fun and romantic!
You could make preparations and choices for your wedding day by going to 6 important places: a bridal shop with lots of wedding dresses; a wedding cake store where you could design your wedding cake by yourself; a hair salon where you could try so many different looks with tons of colors and accessories; a florist with various flowers for a bouquet. The most important thing is to choose a church where you could exchange vowels with your life partner and a wedding party location where everybody could celebrate your big day together.
In BoBo World: Wedding, there are 20 characters to play with. They would have many requirements. Fulfill their requests by using many interactive items and doing interactive activities so they won’t be late for wedding. 
【Features】
. 6 wedding related scenes
. 20 characters to play with
. Explore freely with no limits
. Tons of interactive items
. Simulate the real life wedding preparation
. Multi-touch supported. Play with your friends!
. No wifi needed. You could play it anywhere! 
This version of BoBo World Wedding is free to download. Unlock more scenes through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@bobo-world.com

bluejetty:00015008:ios.summary:
Overview
Avaz AAC is an assistive communication app that empowers children & adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Aphasia, Apraxia, and individuals with speech difficulties to communicate freely and build meaningful relationsh
bluejetty:00015008:ios.description:
Overview
Avaz AAC is an assistive communication app that empowers children & adults with Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Down Syndrome, Aphasia, Apraxia, and individuals with speech difficulties to communicate freely and build meaningful relationships.
Why Families Trust Avaz
“My daughter has nearly mastered navigation, so much so that one day she brought it to me to show me she wanted Taco Bell for lunch. This made me cry. My child had a voice for the first time. Thank you for being the one to give my daughter that "voice". - Amy Kinderman
Designed to aid language development, by presenting core words, which make up 80% of everyday speech, in a research-based order. This enables users to progress from using 1-2 word phrases to forming complete sentences.
Core AAC Features
Avaz, a fully AAC text-to-speech app with over 40,000 pictures(Symbolstix) and a range of high-quality voices, enables users to form sentences and express themselves with ease quickly. Avaz is a customizable AAC app that empowers users to express themselves authentically and build meaningful connections!
Secure Backup & Restore
Enjoy the convenience of auto backup for worry-free vocabulary progress. Simply choose how often you want your vocabulary progress backed up with our auto-backup interval selection option. Never lose your progress again!
Personalization with Themes
We understand our users have different preferences for cloud storage, so we made it easy to back up your vocabulary to your preferred platform, including popular ones like Google Drive.
Explore our visual themes - Classic Light, Classic Dark (with high contrast), and Outer Space (a dark mode). Our default dark mode has been beneficial for adult users and those using Avaz with eye-tracking devices.
Free Trial – No Credit Card Required
Try Avaz AAC's free 14-day trial without adding credit card details! Make in-app purchases and choose from our affordable monthly, yearly, and lifetime subscription plans to keep benefiting from the amazing features.
Available in Major Languages
Now available in English US, English UK, Français, Dansk, Svenska, Magyar, Føroyskt is fully compatible with iPads and iPhones.
Responsive Support
If you’re new to AAC, don’t worry! Visit www.avazapp.com for beginner-friendly articles to help you get started. Connect with our passionate Avaz community on Facebook and other social media platforms.
We are always happy to hear from you. For any assistance, please write to us at support@avazapp.com
Note for Schools: Avaz AAC - Lifetime Edition is available for a one-time purchase and offers a 50% discount with VPP for 20+ licenses.
Terms of Use - https://www.avazapp.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy - https://www.avazapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00061604:ios.name: Remote Mouse Pro
bluejetty:00061604:ios.summary: Remote Mouse™ transforms your mobile phone or tablet into an easy-to-use remote control for your computer, complete with a cross-device clipboard that enables seamless text and image transfer across platforms. It mimics the functions of a w
bluejetty:00061604:ios.description:
Remote Mouse™ transforms your mobile phone or tablet into an easy-to-use remote control for your computer, complete with a cross-device clipboard that enables seamless text and image transfer across platforms. It mimics the functions of a wireless mouse, keyboard, and touchpad, and also offers various specialized control panels that enhance your control over specific operations. The small features, designed for one-handed use or intuitive operations, will delight you.
Featured on CNET, Mashable, and Product Hunt, Remote Mouse is recognized as one of the most sophisticated and user-friendly computer remote apps. With over 20 million users worldwide, it's a trusted choice for effortless computer control.
Whether you're watching a movie online, giving a presentation, or shutting down your computer with one click, nothing can be more convenient than having a mobile phone remote at your fingertips.
Mouse
• Fully simulated mouse function
• Gyro mouse is a feature that allows you to move the mouse cursor with a gyro sensor
• Left-handed mode
Keyboard
• Integrated with system and third-party keyboards, supports typing in various languages
• Remotely typing by voice if the soft keyboard supports speech recognition
• Supports sending various shortcuts
• Displays different keypads for Mac or PC
Touchpad
• Simulates the Apple Magic Trackpad and supports multi-touch gestures
Specialty Control Panels
• Media Remote: Control videos, music, and presentations across apps and sites like YouTube, Netflix, Disney+, Apple TV+, VLC, Spotify, and more, automatically adapting to what’s playing.
• Web Remote: Supports Chrome, Firefox, and Opera
• Application Switcher: quickly launch and switch between programs
• Power Options: Supports remotely shutting down, sleeping, restarting, and logging off
• Cross-device Clipboard: Allows for the transfer of text and images between your computer and mobile device
Other Features
• Use the physical volume buttons on the mobile device for remote control
• Set a password for the connection
• Customizable wallpaper
Connection Method
• Connect via IP address or QR code
• Connect via history
Operating Environment
• Compatible with Windows, Mac OSX, and Linux
• Works under Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
To Get Started
1. Visit https://www.remotemouse.net on your computer and download the Remote Mouse computer server software.
2. Install and run the computer server software.
3. Connect your mobile device to the same Wi-Fi network or use Bluetooth to pair with your computer.

bluejetty:00031071:ios.description:

What Will You Get with eSIM io?

bluejetty:00040328:ios.name: Meditation Time 2.0
bluejetty:00040328:ios.summary: The ‘Meditation Time App’ provides you with a very useful tool to make your meditation even more mindful: Set the timer and let one of the many singing bowls and instruments remind you of the end of your meditation after the desired time.
bluejetty:00040328:ios.description:
The ‘Meditation Time App’ provides you with a very useful tool to make your meditation even more mindful: Set the timer and let one of the many singing bowls and instruments remind you of the end of your meditation after the desired time.
If you wish, you can also set a mindfulness chime at any interval to gently bring you back to meditation if your thoughts do wander.
Pleasant nature sounds as switchable background sounds help you meditate when your mind (or your environment) is particularly restless.
Our guided meditations by professional speakers provide you with additional guidance and motivation for your daily meditation practice.
The ‘teaching’ provides a brief and undogmatic overview of the most important aspects of meditation practice and offers you inspiration and motivation for your regular meditation.
Conclusion: This app is perfect for you if you want to bring more mindfulness into your life with meditation. It doesn't matter whether you've never meditated before or are an old hand at meditation. By the way: since version 4.0, we have even built in special modes for the masters of meditation: the Master Mode for up to 4 hours of meditation at a time and the Zen Mode, which sounds the end chime three times. 
With this in mind, I wish you: a peaceful mind and a calm disposition.
Why use a meditation app at all?
A meditation app offers a simple and accessible way to regularly integrate mindfulness and inner peace into your everyday life. It helps to reduce stress, promote concentration and increase general well-being. Especially in a hectic world where we are often overwhelmed by obligations and distractions, a meditation app helps to create moments of calm and to arrive in the here and now. 
There is an important connection between meditation apps and the concept of MBSR (Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction), a scientifically based method for reducing stress. MBSR uses mindfulness exercises such as meditation, breathing techniques and body scans to manage stress and chronic strain. Many meditation apps are based on similar principles and offer guided exercises that integrate the central elements of MBSR. This allows users to benefit from the proven techniques and integrate mindfulness into their everyday lives - whether to manage stress, improve sleep or promote serenity.
This app can write your completed meditation sessions to Apple Health (HealthKit), allowing you to track your mindfulness practice in the Health app. Data is only shared with your explicit permission and can be disabled at any time.

bluejetty:00033894:ios.description:
Step into the ring and experience the adrenaline-pumping action of Boxing Ring: Clash of Warriors, a mobile boxing game that sets a new standard for engaging gameplay. Featuring high-quality animations and lifelike boxer models, this game offers a realistic and thrilling boxing experience right at your fingertips.
Become the worldwide champion, fighting in breathtaking arenas from San Francisco to Shanghai and more! Look your opponents in the eye and prepare yourself for the fight to remember. There can be only one victor - make sure it’s you!
Key Features:
- Diverse Opponents: Engage in over 100 intense fights with a wide array of opponents, each with their unique fighting style and strategy.
- League Progression: Climb the ranks through 6 challenging leagues, with each one culminating in an epic boss fight that will test your skills to the limit.
- Championship Glory: Strive to obtain 6 prestigious boxing belts, marking your conquest through various leagues and solidifying your status as a true boxing champion.
- Global Showdown: Immerse yourself in the world of boxing as you compete in famous locations around the globe, including vibrant cities like Shanghai, San Francisco, and more!
- Engaging character builder: Customize your boxer's abilities with 4 distinct stats to upgrade, allowing you to tailor your fighting style to match your strategic preferences.
- Awesome Mini-Games: Hone your skills with two unique mini-games - the punching bag for precision and the jumping rope for agility - providing a break from the ring with enjoyable challenges.
- Dynamic Combat: Unleash a variety of powerful punches, including jabs, hooks, and uppercuts, to crush your opponents and dominate the ring.
- Defensive Tactics to learn: Master the art of defense with dodge and block maneuvers to skillfully avoid incoming punches and counter with precision.
- Special Moves: Execute jaw-dropping special moves that can turn the tide of the match, providing you with the opportunity to finish off your opponent in style.
Boxing Ring: Clash of Warriors offers an unparalleled mobile boxing experience, combining awesome visuals, strategic gameplay, and a variety of features that will keep you hooked from the first bell to the final knockout. Enter the ring, rise through the ranks, and become the ultimate boxing champion!
IGRS rating: 13+

Struggling with anxiety? Feeling overwhelmed? Need a daily dose of hope? Gen Z Bible transforms ancient wisdom into relatable guidance that speaks your language. This isn't your grandparent's scripture app. It's a mental wellness tool designed specifically for today's challenges.
Match Your Mood to Scripture That Gets You
Browse our vibrant mood collection featuring anxiety, depression, joy, love, doubt, and more—each with specially curated verses that actually make sense for what you're going through.
Daily Vibe Check: SOAP Method for Emotional Balance
Scripture: Start with truth that grounds you
Observation: Process what you're really feeling
Application: Get practical steps for your situation
Prayer: Connect spiritually in your own authentic way
Why Gen Z Bible Stands Out:
Mood-Based Scripture & Encouragement
Pick your vibe; anxiety, depression, joy, relationships, stress, anger, love, and more. Get Bible verses, reflections, and prayers tailored to exactly how you feel.
Bible Stories Reimagined
Explore iconic Bible stories with modern visuals and real-life lessons. From David’s courage to Ruth’s loyalty; faith has never looked this relatable.
Emotional & Mental Health Support
Struggling with anxiety, loneliness, or stress? Gen Z Bible offers spiritual tools to help you cope, heal, and grow stronger; without judgment.
Aesthetic & Intuitive Design
Custom artwork, calming UI, and smooth navigation. Designed for Gen Z, by Gen Z. Save your favs, set reminders, and share the Word.
Built-In Faith Community
Connect with others on the same journey. Share your reflections, join discussions, and grow your faith together.
Find Exactly What You Need:
Anxiety Relief: Calm your mind with verses that actually help
Daily Devotionals: Quick spiritual boosts for busy lives
Relationship Guidance: Navigate complex connections with wisdom
Identity & Purpose: Discover who you are beyond social expectations
Healing & Growth: Process grief, doubt and life transitions

Abandon the monotony of a desk job and embrace your inner chef and idler, as you navigate Oliver's journey from an ordinary clerk to a celebrated street food entrepreneur.

Embrace the role of an idle vlogger, sharing Oliver's journey and enticing more customers with your culinary tales.
This game is perfect for fans of idle games and culinary adventures alike. With intuitive gameplay and engaging mechanics, 'Idle Kitchen: Food Truck' is an idle game that transcends the genre, offering a unique blend of cooking, managing, and storytelling. Join the ranks of successful idlers and transform your food truck into a gastronomic sensation!

Join the world of the most comfortable bus journeys with our updated app from Ecolines. Discover instant access to the best routes, bus tickets, services, long-distance travel, and various destinations that will make your next trip unforgettable.
Why ECOLINES?
EXPERIENCE AND RELIABILITY
Ecolines is one of Europe's largest and most experienced bus operators, with 20 years of experience in the market. We know the roads we travel and always aim to meet our passengers' expectations.
CONVENIENT AND INTUITIVE INTERFACE
Instant bus ticket search, seat selection, and online booking in just a few clicks, whether it's for yourself, your loved ones, or friends. Save your purchase history, create templates for even faster booking, and get access to special offers and discounts.
TRIP DETAILS IN YOUR SMARTPHONE
View all the necessary information about your journey, including tickets, routes, and the bus stop timetable.
BUS SCHEDULE
Convenient trip planning with instant access to the current bus schedule in the app. Choose a stop in the city of your choice and view arrival and departure details for routes on the current day.
EXTENSIVE VARIETY OF ROUTES
We offer comfortable travel to 20 countries and approximately 205 cities every day. Our buses travel through the territories of the Baltic countries, Poland, Germany, the Netherlands, the Czech Republic, Ukraine, and more.
COMFORTABLE BUSES AND ON-BOARD SERVICES
Bus cabins are equipped with free Wi-Fi, multimedia systems, and onboard staff to assist with any questions, along with the option to enjoy tea or coffee.
With the Ecolines app, your journey becomes easy and enjoyable. Download the app now and plan your next trip! Join the thousands of satisfied passengers who trust their bus travels to the Ecolines.
Share your impressions and feedback, and please don’t hesitate to contact us at info@ecolines.lv if you have any questions.
