bluejetty:00027608:ios.description:
If you’re looking for a way to diversify your trainings and try something new and trendy, Wall Pilates is a great option.
The wall can add resistance to your regular workout routine, and it can also take your moves up a notch by adding elevation.
Wall Pilates workouts by Fit & Lean aim to:
- Target every problem area (glutes, legs, inner and outer thighs, back, waist, hips, and abs)
- Increase muscular endurance
- Improve posture and balance
- Strengthen core and back muscles 
- Improve flexibility and deepen stretch
The movements are slow and controlled, which makes exercises perfect for those who are new to Pilates or are looking for a low-impact workout.
 Find a wall nearby and give Fit & Lean a try! You’ll certainly feel like you have worked, and you’ll definitely feel how the wall supports some of the movements and adds challenge to others. 
Ready? Let's get to work! 
Fit & Lean offers different types of subscriptions so that you can choose the right one for you (3 months access renewal, 1 month access renewal etc.). Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel your subscriptions at any time in your iTunes account settings. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00021399:ios.name: miCal - The missing Calendar
bluejetty:00021399:ios.summary:
miCal is THE calendar that you’ve always wished your iPhone or iPad had! miCal makes scheduling easier, clearer—and better looking—than ever before.
Quick Overview
The dashboard displays your current appointments and events, tasks and birt
bluejetty:00021399:ios.description:
miCal is THE calendar that you’ve always wished your iPhone or iPad had! miCal makes scheduling easier, clearer—and better looking—than ever before.
Quick Overview
The dashboard displays your current appointments and events, tasks and birthdays. You can also see the current weather and an overview of the current month at a glance.
Intuitive Controls 
Intuitively navigate through your calendars and quickly, easily add events and tasks thanks to predefined settings and simple controls. Standard settings like repeating events and reminders/alarms are just a tap away. And powerful special settings are also available, without sacrificing comfort or control. Swipe through views and open events or days with just a tap.
miCal Understands You
Quickly create events with the new natural language input feature. Natural language input allows you to create events just by describing them. And if you have Siri enabled on your device, you can even dictate your event details instead of typing.
The Total Package
miCal provides complete, well-organized day, week and month views and displays the calendar week in all the important views.
Relax
You don’t need to contort yourself with miCal. miCal supports portrait as well as landscape formats in nearly every view. Use each view however it’s most comfortable for you.
Tasks/Reminders
miCal now supports iOS reminders. Create reminders for all the important tasks in your private and professional life right in the app.
Birthday Manager
Never again miss an important birthday. Get reminders at preset times featuring the music of your choice.
Nice Weather
Five-day weather forecasts plus the sunrise/sunset times, humidity and wind speed for the current day. The dashboard even features a quick summary of the current weather as well as a brief forecast of the coming days.
Comprehensive
miCal offers a unique range of features. Copy, move or send your events. Export your events in the date range of your choice as CSV (for Excel, etc.) or ICS (the calendar format). Set colors for your calendars and individual appointments or automatically add colors based on keywords in event titles.
Up to Date and Secure
miCal communicates with your device’s integrated calendar. miCal works with all the calendar services that your device currently supports (iCloud, Google Calendar, Outlook, Exchange, Facebook Events, subscriptions) without requiring additional configuration. That way, you can store your data locally or via the services you know and trust—it’s up to you. miCal itself does not transmit any data to external services or other servers. That allows us to ensure 100% data security.
Award-Winning
- 3rd place in the "Best German iPhone App" competition at the 2010 iPhone Developer conference.
- Featured as App of the Week in 13 countries.
- Recommendation from iPhoneWelt and a 5-star rating from iPhone&Co, two of the leading iPhone magazines
- Honored at the 2010 App Developer Conference

bluejetty:00027031:ios.name: Acadia National Park GPS Guide
bluejetty:00027031:ios.summary:
Experience Acadia National Park in Bar Harbor, Maine through a narrated self-guided driving tour. Discover stunning vistas, scenic lookouts, and the park's vibrant foliage at your own pace.
Experience the most beautiful sights Maine has to
bluejetty:00027031:ios.description:
Experience Acadia National Park in Bar Harbor, Maine through a narrated self-guided driving tour. Discover stunning vistas, scenic lookouts, and the park's vibrant foliage at your own pace.
Experience the most beautiful sights Maine has to offer! This tour guides you through Acadia’s picturesque wilderness, and introduces you to the vibrant history of both the park and Bar Harbor itself.
Learn about the Native American tribes who once called this place home, and the legends they passed down over the centuries. Hear tales of great celestial bears, hunts that change the seasons, and more!
Dive deep into the flora and fauna of Acadia as we show you the very best hiking trails and overlooks. Get the inside scoop on the Rockefellers’ connection to the park. And, of course, reach the summit of the majestic Cadillac Mountain.
Featuring riveting stories, a phenomenal narrator, and easy automatic audio, this app puts exploration in the palm of your hand!
Explore the rich natural wonders of Acadia National Park:
■ Bar Island
■ La Rochelle & The Gilded Age
■ Foliage & Fire
■ Hulls Cove Visitor Center
■ Cadillac Mountain Overlook
■ Park Loop & Kebo Golf
■ Great Meadow
■ Sieur de Monts Spring
■ Beaver Pond
■ Jackson Labs
■ Egg Rock Overlook
■ Precipice Trail & Peregrine Falcon
■ Schooner Head Overlook
■ Ocean Path Trailhead
■ Sand Beach
■ Sand Beach Overlook
■ Old Soaker
■ Thunder Hole
■ Monument Cove
■ Gorham Mountain Trailhead
■ Boulder Beach
■ Otter Cliff & Cove
■ Hunters Beach Overlook
■ Jordan Pond & House Restaurant
■ Bubbles Divide Trail
■ Bubble Pond
■ Eagle Lake
■ Bald Porcupine Island
■ Cadillac Mountain Summit
HOW IT WORKS:
As you drive/walk, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour & begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest. 
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase
No monthly subscription. No time limits. No usage limits. Enjoy this tour as many times as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year. 
MORE TOURS
▶ Cades Cove:-
Get an unforgettable Smoky Mountain experience in a bite-sized package, where lush wilderness and rich Civil War history combine to form a destination like no other.
▶ Maine Tours Bundle
Discover the best of Maine with this incredible bundle. Explore Portland's urban delights & the scenic wonders of Acadia National Park. Visit the charming seaside town of Bar Harbor, your gateway to rocky shores, mountain trails, & wildlife. At your own pace.
FREE DEMO vs FULL ACCESS:
Check out the totally free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
QUICK TIPS:
■ Download ahead of time, over data or WiFi.
■ Be sure the phone battery is fully charged or take an external battery pack.
NOTE: 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. This app uses your location service and GPS tracking feature to allow real-time tracking of your route.

bluejetty:00022370:ios.summary:

• Please
bluejetty:00022370:ios.description:
• Let the musical muses of Piano Motifs inspire your device to generate some original and beautiful motifs (short melodies).
• Selected as the Favorite MIDI Generator App two years in a row by the iOS Music Production community!
• Please note that Piano Motifs is not an AI app. All motifs are algorithmically generated using music theory.
• Check out the music that Piano Motifs can generate at: https://soundcloud.com/azul-3d
• For Piano Motifs demos and tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/@azul3dapps
• Create original, catchy and inspiring MIDI loops at the touch of a button.
• No musical knowledge or skill is necessary to create completely new and original music. Piano Motifs is the simplest way to generate your own music.
• There are no preset melodies. Melodies are generated algorithmically. The melodic possibilities are endless.
• Set the music tempo or select the key, scale, time signature, octave range, number of bars, melody constraints, melody note frequency and accompaniment style for your motif.
• Option to generate Swing rhythm for the melody, either Shuffle or Hard Swing.
• Program your own chord progressions and let Piano Motifs generate an accompaniment and melody for them.
• Generation of a 3rd track with the option of it being a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone. Ideal for strings, choirs or pads.
• Arrange your motifs to create longer musical pieces.
• Choose from 28 different kinds of accompaniment styles.
• Define your arpeggio accompaniments.
• Choose from 13 different kinds of melody constraints.
• Major, Minor, Lydian, Mixolydian, Dorian, Phrygian, Harmonic Minor and Phrygian Dominant scales supported.
• Loop your motifs
• Save your motifs as MIDI files so you can edit them or add more instrumentation to them on your favorite Digital Audio Workstation (DAW).
• When exporting a MIDI file, export with a third MIDI track with a sustained chord per bar, sustained chord per multiple bars or a drone tone (Ideal for synth pads, strings or chorus).
• Share audio or MIDI through iMessages, e-mail, Whatsapp or AirDrop. Save audio, MIDI or .motif file to your device's file system.
• AUv3 MIDI Plug-In In-App Purchase: 
Incorporate Piano Motifs seemlessly in your workflow by instantiating it once or multiple times in an app that can host AUv3 MIDI Plug-Ins, for example: AUM, AudioBus 3, ApeMatrix, Drambo or EG Nodes. Please note that Piano Motifs as an AUv3 MIDI Plug-In will not play any sound by itself, it generates MIDI that can be routed to other apps and effects instantiated in a host. IMPORTANT: GarageBand does not support MIDI only Plug-ins, so the AUv3 will not work in GarageBand.
• AUv3 MIDI Plug-In features include:
- Ability to play Piano Motifs in sync and out of sync with the host.
- State saving functionality.
- Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment, optional third track, and optional melody harmony track.
- Interactive octave shifting for melody and accompaniment.
- Controllable Melody and Accompaniment Velocity parameters.
- Start Delay and BPM multiple with respect to the Host in Sync mode.
• MIDI Out In-App Purchase: 
Play the music generated by Piano Motifs on your favorite synthesizer, DAW, a connect/route/mix app like AUM, or any app that has Virtual MIDI Destination (MIDI In) capabilities. IMPORTANT: Before purchasing please be aware that Piano Motifs DOES NOT OFFER Ableton Link functionality.
• MIDI Out In-App Purchase features include: 
- Programmable delay for the start of a motif
- Independent programmable MIDI channels for melody, accompaniment and an optional third track
• Piano Motifs chooses a music key from many different scales and an accompaniment from a varied set of accompaniments. Piano Motifs then uses its musical theory algorithms to overlay a melody in the chosen key and accompaniment. Piano Motifs are short, they go from around 16 seconds to around 30 seconds.

bluejetty:00022121:ios.name: Busy Kids + Learn Russian
bluejetty:00022121:ios.summary:
Three languages to learn through play: English, Spanish and Russian. Busy Kids teaches children aged 2 to 7 to read by syllable chunks, from the very first letters to whole fairy tales, with Uni the unicorn as their guide.
A beautiful new
bluejetty:00022121:ios.description:
Three languages to learn through play: English, Spanish and Russian. Busy Kids teaches children aged 2 to 7 to read by syllable chunks, from the very first letters to whole fairy tales, with Uni the unicorn as their guide.
A beautiful new kids' interface: the whole menu is one rotating ball of clouds, and every cloud opens a story, a game or a tune.
THREE LANGUAGES, ONE APP
• Pick the language each child learns: games, stories and voice follow along
• A gentle start for beginners: letters, sounds, phonics chunks and first sight words
• Fairy tales in each language, every word voiced
• Perfect for bilingual families: keep Russian alive at home, add English or Spanish
WORD WORKSHOP - THE HEART OF THE APP
A talking keyboard: your child types any word and every letter speaks. The word splits into chunks (with syllable rainbows above in Russian), then Uni, Kitty or Robby hops across them and reads each one aloud. Type English, Spanish or Russian, even two alphabets in one phrase (МАМА CAT), pick the look of the letters, and record the reading as a video to send to grandma.
READ AND WRITE
• Word Workshop - type, listen, split words into chunks
• Fairy Tales - illustrated tales in each language, every word voiced; tap a chunk to hear it
• Build a Word - a crane game that stacks words and builds an island town
• Find a Letter - a letter-catching adventure across a big map
• Tracing - lines, Latin and Cyrillic letters, then whole words
WORLD AROUND
• Discovery World - tap objects in lively panoramas and hear their names
• I Spy - spoken riddles
• Room - unlock objects by spelling their names
PUZZLE GAMES
• Memory: Letters, Memory: Chunks
• Picture Puzzles
• Boxes - box-pushing logic puzzles
• Containers - more brain teasers
DRAW AND PLAY MUSIC
• Coloring - pages in many themes, plus free Drawing
• Piano, Drums, Melodies - ready-made songs to play and your own tunes to compose
REWARDS AND FRIENDS
• Earn stars and fill a sticker album, shareable to WhatsApp and Telegram
• Pick a friend: Uni the unicorn, Kitty the kitten or Robby the robot
FOR PARENTS
• No ads
• A profile for every child: own progress, language, play timer and drawings
• Daily play-time limit and progress stats
• Parental gate on purchases, the parents' area and sharing
• Games work offline
SUBSCRIPTION & PURCHASES
Try it free: every day each child gets "suns" - 3 a day for one child, 2 each for two or three children (one visit to an activity costs one sun). Premium unlocks everything: unlimited play, all friends and up to 10 profiles. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase; the monthly plan has a 3-day free trial and the yearly plan a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions and purchases from earlier versions carry over. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage them and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings. Stickers are never sold for money: kids earn them with stars.
Questions or ideas: hello@editale.com
Privacy Policy: https://bukovki.app/policies/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00041277:ios.description:
Here in the forest, a red door appears at night.
For some time now, it has been called the Hall of the Inquirers.
It is easy to get in, but not so easy to get out.
When you emerge from the hall, you will be in possession of magical powers
Will you be able to leave?
The long and short night is about to begin.
■◇■------- Features -------■◇■
This escape games is a large scale puzzle solving world consisting of 3 stages.
All controls are simple, just tap the screen.
You can start the game from the middle of the stage because the game automatically saves your progress.
If you get stuck on how to proceed, "hints" and "answers" are provided so that you can proceed smoothly to the end.
You can enjoy the game for free until the end.
This Escape room contains a rich levels packed with escape puzzles.
This game is an adventure escape mystery.
Now, enjoy the escape game.
■◇■------- How to play -------■◇■
Tap the place you are interested in and check it out!
　You may be able to solve a puzzle or find an item.
Tap the item box to zoom in on the item you have obtained.
Items can be combined with other items or used in the field.
Hints for solving puzzles are hidden in various places. Tap in various places to find clues.
If you are not sure how to proceed or how to solve a puzzle, you can use the "Hint" button.
　If you are not sure how to proceed or how to solve a puzzle, you can use the "Hint" button.
　If you still can't solve the puzzle after looking at the "Hints," there is an "Answer" button to help you solve the puzzle.
If you want to start from the middle of the puzzle, click the "CONTINUE" button on the title screen to continue.
■◇■------- Provided by -------■◇■
We used sound effects from the following sites.
Pocket Sound http://pocket-se.info/
Sound Effect Lab https://soundeffect-lab.info/

bluejetty:00043303:ios.name: Speetar Health - سبيتار صحة
bluejetty:00043303:ios.summary: يعد تطبيق سبيتار ترجمةً لرؤية المؤسسة بضرورة توفير رعاية صحّية عالية الجودة لجميع من يحتاجها وأينما كان، حيث يمثّل التطبيق نموذجًا رائدًا في التوظيف الأمثل للتكنولوجيا لتقديم مستوى عالٍ من الرعاية الصحّية، موفّرًا العديد من المزايا ولاغيًا
bluejetty:00043303:ios.description:
يعد تطبيق سبيتار ترجمةً لرؤية المؤسسة بضرورة توفير رعاية صحّية عالية الجودة لجميع من يحتاجها وأينما كان، حيث يمثّل التطبيق نموذجًا رائدًا في التوظيف الأمثل للتكنولوجيا لتقديم مستوى عالٍ من الرعاية الصحّية، موفّرًا العديد من المزايا ولاغيًا حواجز الزمان والمكان، لتصبح الرعاية الصحّية ذات الجودة حقيقةً يمكن للجميع معايشتها بصرف النظر عن ظروفهم وأماكن عيشهم وقدرتهم على الوصول لخدمات الرعاية الصحّية المتخصّصة.
خدمات التطبيق
حجز استشارة عبر الإنترنت -
يمكنك عبر تطبيق سبيتار حجز استشارة عبر الإنترنت من منزلك، حيث يوفّر لك التطبيق إمكانية الاختيار بين أكثر من 35 تخصص طبّي مختلف، بالإضافة لأكثر من 1000 طبيب من داخل ليبيا وخارجها.
يمكنك التحدّث مع الطبيب المختص من خلال مكالمة صوتية، مكالمة فيديو أو من خلال الرسائل القصيرة.
يمكنك رؤية الملف الشخصي للطبيب وتقييماته السابقة من قبل مستخدمين سبق لهم الحجز عنده لمساعدتك في الاختيار.
سيطلب منك التطبيق إدخال بعض الأعراض التي تعاني منها لمساعدة الطبيب المختصّ في تكوين صورة مبدئيّة عن حالتك.
سيتم إرسال إشعار لك لتذكيرك بموعد الاستشارة الخاصّة بك.
خدمة الرعاية المنزليّة - ليبيا -
يوفّر التطبيق إمكانيّة طلب خدمة الرعاية الصحّية داخل ليبيا، حيث أنّه بمجرّد تعبئتك للنموذج المرفق سيقوم فريق سبيتار بربطك بأنسب مزوّد رعاية صحيّة لتلبية طلبك في أسرع وقت.
تشمل خدمات الرعاية المنزليّة:
تركيب المحاليل الوريديّة، إعطاء الأدوية عبر الوريد والعضل.
الغيار على الجروح وفك الغرز.
فحص الضغط والسكّر.
متابعة العلامات الحيويّة.
العلاج الطبيعي:
التأهيل بعد العمليّات.
حالات الشلل الدماغي.
حالات آلام الظهر والرقبة.
حالات الجلطة الدماغيّة.
الكسور وأمراض العظام والعضلات.
العناية بتقرّحات الفراش.
أخذ مسحات كورونا لفحص ال PCR
أخذ عينات تحاليل دم.
تركيب القسطرة البوليّة.
حجز استشارة في المصحّة - ليبيا -
يوفّر لك التطبيق أيضًا إمكانيّة حجز موعد لدى أحد الأطبّاء في إحدى المصحّات الموجودة في ليبيا، حيث سيوفّر عليك ذلك عناء الوقوف في طوابير الانتظار الطويلة ومخالطة أعداد كبيرة من الناس، مما سيقلل من احتمالية انتقال مختلف أنواع العدوى لك لا قدّر الله.
يمكنك حجز استشارة من خلال البحث عن اسم الطبيب الذي ترغب في الحجز عنده، أو من خلال اختيار أحد الأطبّاء المصنّفين وفق تخصّصاتهم وأماكن تواجدهم في مصحّات ليبيا ومراكزها الطبّية المختلفة.
إنشاء ملف صحّي إلكتروني
هل عانيت مسبقًا من تكرار ضياع نتائج تحاليلك ووثائقك الصحّية؟
يمكنك عبر تطبيق سبيتار إنشاء ملف صحّي إلكتروني خاص بك يمكنك من خلاله استقبال وإرسال الوصفات الطبّية، نتائج التحاليل، صور الأشعّة وغيرها من الوثائق الطبّية التي يمكنك الاحتفاظ بها بسهولة وأمان داخل ملفك الشخصي على التطبيق.
مميزات تطبيق سبيتار
سهولة الاستخدام.
توفير درجة عالية من الخصوصية.
فريق دعم متوفّر على مدار الساعة لاستقبال الملاحظات.
مرونة وتعدّد طرق الدفع.
أكثر من 35 تخصص طبّي.
أكثر من 1000 طبيب من داخل ليبيا وخارجها.
ملائم للهواتف بمختلف أنواعها.
للتواصل معنا:
Website: https://www.speetar.com
Twitter: https://twitter.com/speetarhealthi
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/speetarhealth
Email: info@speetar.com

bluejetty:00033586:ios.description:
Do you want to see what your baby would look like? Now you can! Thanks to AI (Artificial Intelligence) and cutting-edge machine learning technologies.
Easy way to find out what you and your partner’s future baby will look like with this awesome app!!! Try it with your boyfriends/girlfriends photo and amaze your partner with your future kids !!!
Baby Face Generator Future Kid Basic Feature:
TIME MACHINE
- What will you look like when you’re older? Your OLD version: Explore with our popular AI Old filter time machine, a true Aging booth that allows time to change your face.
PHOTO TO CARTOON
- Choose a fabulous image from your photo lab to caricature or snap a selfie using a cartoon camera. Resize the pic so no crop is needed. Explore the superb cartoon face filters for pictures to cartoony photos!
3D CARTOON PHOTO EDITOR
- Based on our latest powerful technology, just with one touch, you can use our cartoon filters to transform your selfie into 3D cartoon effects.
Baby Face Generator Future Kid Premium:
FUTURE BABY PREDICTOR
- Generate your baby's face! and have fun! We use advanced machine learning algorithms to make your baby's face. The photo should be in portrait for the best result.
CELEBRITY LOOK ALIKE
- Find your celebrity look-alike now - with new faster comparisons and improved accuracy thanks to machine learning, take a photo that will find your celebrity match.
GENDER SWAP
- Curious about your male or female version? Masculine or feminine? See what you'd look like as a different gender.
BECOME YOUNG
- With AI technology supported, it's possible to go back to your childhood again. After applying this effect, you can easily get younger and look like a teenager.
PHOTO ENHANCE
- Bring old, grainy, pixelated, broken, low-resolution photos into a brand new, high-resolution, perfectly clear picture.

This app is a comprehensive practice guide designed to help you succeed in the G1 Ontario Driving Knowledge Written Test. With a large collection of realistic questions and interactive features, this app makes studying both effective and engaging.

• Hundreds of Practice Questions: Access a wide range of questions that closely resemble those in the actual Driving Knowledge Test.
• Realistic Test Experience: Familiarize yourself with the test format and types of questions to build confidence.
• Modern & User-Friendly Design: Enjoy a sleek and intuitive design that enhances your studying experience.
• Review and Learn: Go through detailed answer reviews to better understand the correct answers.
• Track Your Progress: Keep a record of your past tests to monitor your improvement over time.
• Practice Incorrect Answers: Focus on questions you previously got wrong to strengthen your knowledge.
• Create Random Quizzes: Generate customized quizzes to practice more effectively and target your weak areas.
• Leaderboard: Earn points for practicing and taking quizzes, and compete with others to see where you rank!
Disclaimer: This app is solely for practice purposes and is not affiliated with or operated by any government agency. While we have made every attempt to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the information, it is provided “as is” without any warranty.

bluejetty:00026806:ios.description:
This App offers access to Marine Charts for USA,Canada,UK/Ireland,Germany,Netherlands/Holland &
Europe Rivers (Danube,Drava,Rhein etc). Coverage includes NOAA marine vector
charts,freshwater lake maps,USACE inland river maps (HD/1ft/3ft bathymetry
included where available),charts derived from UKHO & CHS data. First marine GPS app to have route assistance with Voice Prompts for marine navigation. You can create new boating routes or import existing GPX/KML routes. It supports Nautical Charts course up orientation. Includes Tide & Currents prediction.
►FEATURES
√ Beautiful & detailed Hardware/GPU accelerated vector charts (text stays upright on rotation)
√ Long press to query the details of Marine object (Buoy,Lights,Obstruction etc).
√ Customizable depth(Ft/Fathom/Meter) & distance units(km/mi/NM)
√ Customizable Shallow Depth.
√ Record tracks,Autofollow with real-time track overlay & predicted path vector.
√ Voice Prompts for marine navigation (requires GPS )
√ 1ft / 3ft depth contour maps for anglers for selected lake maps.
√ Supports GPX/KML for boating route editing/import.
√ Tide & Currents prediction.
√ Seamless chart quilting of marine charts
√ Enter or import Waypoints.
► MAPS
It includes unlimited updates for 1 year. 
√USA: The maps include coverage of all NOAA marine vector charts (ENC),USACE inland river maps,freshwater lake maps for more than 7K lakes. The charts include HD/1ft/3ft bathymetry where available.Incl. NOAA raster where ENC not available. 
√Canada:Incl. CHS data(incl. major Lakes).
√UK/Ireland: Derived from UKHO charts.
√Australia
√Germany: derived from BSH data
√Europe Inland Rivers:Donau/Dunaja,Rhine,Garonne,Moselle,Drava,Sava,etc
√Norway
√Finland
√Sweden
√Croatia
√Ukraine(Black Sea)
√Caribbean
√New Zealand

√Cyprus

√Seychelles& Mauritius
√Denmark

√S. China&Malaysia
√South Africa

√ Move Points

√ Delete / Rename points
√ Import GPX,KML & KMZ files
√ Plot/Edit Routes 
√ Enter Waypoints
√ Share/Export Routes,Tracks&Markers
√ Reverse Routes
►SLIP TO SLIP AUTO ROUTING 
►GPS FEATURES
√ Auto Follow
 * Real Time Track Overlay
 * Predicted Path Vector
 * Course Up(Text stays upright)
 * Speed & Heading
√ Route Assistance With Voice Prompts
 * Prompts when approaching a boating route marker
 * Continous distance & ETA updates
 * Alerts when sailing/boating off route
 * Alerts when boating in wrong direction
√ Record Tracks
►TIDE & CURRENTS
 * For US,Canada,UK,Germany & New Zealand
 * High/Low Tides
 * Tidal Current Prediction

►Instrumentation
√ Marine AIS & (NMEA AIS and GPS over TCP/UDP)

bluejetty:00037883:ios.description:
Rhythm with Tabla & Tanpura is your all-in-one app to practice, compose, or perform Indian classical music. Singers, dancers and composers get realistic tabla, tanpura, manjeera and swarmandal at their fingertips.
* Easy to use
* Beautiful tone of manual tabla and tanpura
Key Features:
* 10 tabla taals free, 60+ with the Full Pack.
* Tabla fillers and a closing tihai.
* Manjeera for accompaniment with tabla (Full Pack).
* 1 tanpura pattern free, all 18 with the Full Pack.
* 2 tanpura voices, and 2 tanpuras at a time.
* Swarmandal with 115+ raags.
* C# scale free, all 12 scales with the Full Pack.
* Individual instrument's pitch fine tuner, volume and tempo control.
* Left and right pan for each instrument, best heard on headphones.
* Beat counter with progress, useful at very low tempo.
* Vibrate on Beat (can be turned off from settings).
* Karaoke style tabla bol highlighter.
* Session Manager to save and load your practice setups.
* No time limit, keeps playing with the screen off.
* Settings for vibration, screen awake, taal sorting and more.
* Tabla loop count and duration to track your practice.
Tabla:
- Control tempo between 10 - 720.
- Sam marked by a bell, with its own volume in settings.
- Control scale of bayan as per your needs.
- Fillers add variations between cycles, as often and busy as you like.
- End button plays a closing tihai landing on sam.
Tanpura:
- Control tempo between 40 - 150.
- Choose between three playing styles: 5 beat (North Indian), 6 beat (Carnatic) or 4 beat (Even).
- Choose between two voices, a deeper original and a brighter, higher one.
- Add a second tanpura, with its own note, voice, tempo and volume.
Swarmandal:
- Play Aroha and Avaroha.
- Control tempo between 60 - 720.
- Choose repeat interval.
Full Pack (one-time purchase):
- 60+ taals and more variations of each taal.
- All 18 tanpura patterns.
- All 12 scales.
- Manjeera.
- No ads.

bluejetty:00017703:ios.description:
Securely bank wherever and whenever you want with CentralMOBILE from Central Bank. Available for free to all Central Bank CentralNET customers, CentralMOBILE allows you to deposit checks, pay bills, view account activity, find locations and more.
REGISTER - To use CentralMOBILE, you must first be enrolled in CentralNET online banking. To use the CentralMOBILE APP, simply download the APP, to use the browser you will need to register your device in CentralNET to receive the browser address and an activation code.
FEATURES: 
MOBILE CHECK DEPOSIT - Snap photos of checks and deposit them right from your smartphone. Just sign the back snap, and send.
CHECK BALANCES – See your latest checking and savings account balances and recent transactions.
TRANSFER FUNDS - Easily transfer cash between your eligible Central Bank accounts.
PAY BILLS - Make one-time payments from anywhere and change or cancel pending payments you have entered through CentralMOBILE or CentralNET online banking.
ACCESS TO ZELLE® – Provides a fast, safe and easy way to send money to those you know and trust.* Zelle and the Zelle related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are used herein under license. Terms and conditions apply. *Transactions typically occur in minutes when the recipient’s email address or U.S. mobile number is already enrolled with Zelle. Must have a bank account in the U.S. to use Zelle. In order to send payment requests or split payment requests to a U.S. mobile number, the mobile number must already be enrolled with Zelle
FIND LOCATIONS - Find nearby Central Bank branches and ATMs using the iPhone's built-in GPS. Additionally, you can search by Zip code or address.
www.centralbank.com
Central Bank & Trust Co. is a wholly owned subsidiary of Central Bancshares, Lexington, Kentucky.

Please invite your party guests.

This rhythm simulation tycoon game is free!

- Tap and hold tiles to play Piano & Guitar Tiles very easily.
- Tap gift boxes, Do not touch bombs!
- Install your diorama brick party decorations with note tickets earned by playing.
- Tap those gifts from your party guests.
- Open the newly themed party!
- This game can be played offline!
● Game Features ●
- Cute and adorable brick party decorations
- Sweet party guests
- Calm and comfortable music
- High quality of guitar and piano sound
- Soft and fast speed of sound response
Do you want to play calm and comfortable music?
Do you like diorama bricks and tycoon game?
Download and try My Music Tower!

bluejetty:00025409:ios.description:
GhostTube SEER is the world's first AI-powered paranormal investigative tool. The app combines theories of spiritual communication and the human psyche, mind and interpretation using the power of modern-day artificial intelligence. GhostTube SEER adds a new dimension to experimental spiritual communication that is unmatched by traditional tools and experimental techniques.
GhostTube SEER uses your mobile device's actual sensors to measure and react to changes in your environment - It reacts by selecting words from the pre-populated word bank when specific environmental signatures are detected. It then runs selected words through an advanced artificial intelligence algorithm to produce unique, AI-generated visuals. It can also be used with GhostTube Lens, the world's first virtual reality headset for paranormal investigators, for a more immersive experience and adding a whole new dimension to your paranormal experiments.
Features included with the GhostTube SEER artificial intelligence paranormal app:
- Ghost dictionary with thousands of pre-loaded words
- Magnetometer to measure and react to magnetic changes, including the potential presence of EMF
- AI-art generator using advanced artificial intelligence algorithms
- Gallery to manage AI-generated art
- Can be used with GhostTube Lens headset for sensory deprivation experiments*
- Low light video filters to aid video filming in dark places
- Customizable skins and filters to enhance and personalize videos
- Access to GhostTube paranormal community and database with details on over 1000+ haunted places around the world.
*Some features may require in-app purchases, and/or may not be available in all regions.
For more paranormal investigation and ghost hunting tools, check out our other apps.
GhostTube offers in-app purchases and subscriptions. Refer to our website for a full list of terms and conditions: https://ghosttube.com/terms

Paranormal tools in general are designed to measure and react to changes in the environment only. As such, paranormal tools should never be relied on to make important life decisions, as a form of definitive communication, or to cope with grief or loss. Words or sounds generated do not represent the views or opinions of the developer or its affiliates, and they should never be interpreted as instructions or requests.

- Stunning visuals and diverse mountain environments
- Exciting gameplay with different levels and challenges
- Upgrade your income, stamina, and speed to climb higher and faster
- Intuitive controls for a seamless gaming experience
Are you ready to embark on an epic mountain climbing adventure? Download Climb the Mountain now and start your ascent to the top!

apple-macos:6761332019.name: Persuasion
apple-macos:6761332019.description:
Ideas do not win on merit alone. They win when they are understood, trusted, remembered, and acted on.
Persuasion helps people communicate with more clarity, confidence, and impact.
Whether the goal is to pitch an idea, grow a business, perform better in sales, lead a team, prepare for an interview, negotiate more effectively, or simply become more convincing in everyday life, Persuasion teaches the principles that help messages land.
Built around timeless influence principles and modern behavioral insight, Persuasion turns the psychology of persuasion into practical skill.
Inside the app, learners can explore how influence really works, why people say yes, why they resist, how trust is built, and how stronger communication creates better outcomes in work and life.
WITH PERSUASION, USERS CAN:
• Learn core principles of influence in a clear, engaging format
• Build stronger instincts for communication, trust, credibility, and buy-in
• Understand concepts like authority, social proof, reciprocity, scarcity, framing, and more
• Apply persuasive thinking to sales, leadership, marketing, negotiation, interviews, presentations, and everyday conversations
• Strengthen confidence in high-stakes moments where words matter most
DESIGNED FOR:
• Sales professionals
• Founders and entrepreneurs
• Marketers and creators
• Managers and leaders
• Job seekers and professionals
• Students
• Anyone who wants to communicate more effectively
Persuasion is not about manipulation. It is about understanding human behavior, presenting ideas more clearly, and creating genuine influence in an ethical, practical way.
For anyone who wants to become more compelling, more strategic, and more effective when it matters, Persuasion is a smarter way to learn the art and psychology of influence.

apple-macos:6763833379.name: WindTrac: Marine Weather Map
apple-macos:6763833379.description:
WindTrac shows the wind the way it actually moves, and with WindTrac Pro it keeps working when the signal is gone. Download the forecast for where you're heading and the live, animated map of wind, waves and weather goes with you: offshore, into the mountains or onto a plane.
Instead of a grid of arrows or a table of numbers, tens of thousands of particles flow with the forecast wind, speed as colour, direction as motion. The gust front, the light-air hole and the wind bending around a headland are obvious at a glance.
Built for kitesurfers, windsurfers and wing foilers, sailors and boaters, surfers, paraglider pilots and anglers. Anyone who plans the day around the wind and the water.
What makes it different
A forecast that works offline. Most weather apps go blank without a connection. With WindTrac Pro, pick an area and the layers you need, and every forecast hour comes with you, along with the timeline, the animation and the map itself. Keep several areas saved.
Eight forecast models in one app. Switch between NOAA GFS, the NOAA GEFS ensemble mean, DWD ICON and the high-resolution ICON-EU, ECMWF IFS HRES and the ECMWF AIFS AI model, plus two wave models. When the models disagree, you see it straight away.
Numbers where they matter. The strongest gusts, the calmest patches, the biggest waves and the warmest and coldest spots are labelled on the map automatically.
Read the wind
Tap anywhere for the exact speed in knots, km/h, mph or m/s, or switch to gusts to see what you will really be reefing, depowering or scrubbing a launch for. The altitude slider runs from 10 m up through 850, 700, 500 and 250 hPa, from a paraglider launch to the jet stream.
Read the sea
Significant wave height and direction, animated so you can watch a swell roll towards your beach, plus peak and mean wave period to tell a short, choppy wind sea from a long-period groundswell before you load the car. Heights in metres or feet.
Plan the session, the passage or the flight
Drag the timeline to any time in the forecast, or press play and watch a weather system cross the map in seconds. Rain, snow, low cloud and temperature (°C or °F) are a tap away. Save favourite spots and show times in your zone, the spot's or UTC.
Storm Watch
In the US and Canada, official watches and warnings from the National Weather Service and Environment Canada are drawn on the map. Tap one for the full text. Follow hurricanes with the National Hurricane Center's forecast cone, track and 34-knot wind field, which moves with the timeline so you can see when tropical-storm-force wind could arrive. All of it can be switched off.
Free and Pro
The live map, every layer and model, labels, playback, Storm Watch, five saved spots and the next 24 hours of forecast are free, with no ads and no account. WindTrac Pro is an optional subscription that adds offline maps, the full multi-day forecast and unlimited saved spots.
Privacy Policy: https://windtrac.app/privacy
WindTrac is a planning aid, not a substitute for official forecasts and warnings. It is an independent app, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or approved by NOAA, the US National Weather Service, the National Hurricane Center, Environment Canada, ECMWF, DWD, or any other agency whose public data it displays.

apple-macos:6834350144.description:
MuStreamer è il riproduttore musicale audiophile progettato per chi pretende il 100% di fedeltà sonora dal proprio impianto Hi-Fi e dagli streamer di rete UPnP/DLNA (come Naim Mu-so e lettori compatibili).
PURA QUALITÀ BIT-PERFECT FINO A 24-BIT / 192 KHZ
• Streaming lossless FLAC / WAV senza ricampionamenti software né compressione dinamica.
• Integrazione nativa con Qobuz e TIDAL per sfogliare novità, album Studio Master, playlist e brani preferiti direttamente in app.
• Catalogo Hi-Res integrato pronto all'uso per testare subito il tuo impianto.
DECODIFICA LOCALE INTELLIGENTE (OFFLOAD WAV)
Possiedi uno streamer o un diffusore All-in-One con processore meno recente che fatica sui file FLAC 24/192 più pesanti? MuStreamer decodifica il flusso su iPhone/iPad/Mac e invia al tuo impianto un flusso WAV lineare Bit-Perfect leggero e ultra-stabile, eliminando scatti e interruzioni anche su Wi-Fi trafficati.
SUITE DI STRUMENTI HI-FI INTEGRATA
• VU Meter Analogico Stereo: risposta calibrata per monitorare in tempo reale livelli RMS e picchi di ciascun canale.
• Analizzatore di Spettro (RTA): visualizza l'energia acustica da 20 Hz a oltre 20.000 Hz per individuare risonanze della stanza.
• Fonometro SPL: misura la pressione sonora in dB(A) e dB(C) nel punto d'ascolto tramite il microfono del dispositivo.
• Generatore di Segnali & Toni: rumore rosa, rumore bianco e toni sinusoidali continui (20 Hz – 20 kHz) per tarare diffusori e subwoofer.
• Equalizzatore parametrico a 10 bande personalizzabile.
PRIVACY AL 100%
Nessun tracciamento pubblicitario, nessuna profilazione e nessun dato personale raccolto. I token restano protetti nel Portachiavi Apple locale.

apple-macos:6820558776.name: FortyNote
apple-macos:6820558776.description:
FortyNote is a notes app that opens from your phone, not from the network.
Your notes are encrypted on your phone before they are uploaded. We store ciphertext.
WRITE ANYTHING
Headings, lists, checkboxes and tasks, tables, callouts, toggles, code, links, photos, sketches, diagrams, scans, files and voice notes. Colour, highlight, fonts and alignment. Shortcuts as you type, and undo and redo on the keyboard bar.
FIND IT LATER
Tap search and type any word you remember. Matches appear as you type, across every note's title and body.
You rarely remember the title. You remember a word that was in it - tokyo, boiler, cabinets. That is enough.
Words in photos and scans are read on your iPhone, so search finds them too.
WORKS WITHOUT A SIGNAL
Sign in once. Every launch after that reads your notes from the phone and syncs quietly behind you. Write on a plane or on the subway; it catches up when you reconnect.
TASKS AND REMINDERS
Add a task anywhere in a note, give it a due date, flag it. The Tasks screen gathers every task into Overdue, Today, Upcoming, No due date and Completed. Reminders arrive even with the app closed. A calendar shows what is due.
ORGANISE
Notebooks and stacks, tags, pinned notes, shortcuts, saved searches, filters, and a library of templates. Note history lets you put back an earlier version.
TEAMS
Share notebooks with the people on your team. Invite by email, set who manages what, and leave any time.
AI, WHEN YOU ASK FOR IT
Summarise, improve the writing, translate, or ask questions of your notes. Nothing is sent until you agree, and you can turn it off. Or use your own AI key.
YOUR DATA, YOURS TO MOVE
Back up and restore, import from Google Keep and other apps, export as Markdown or web pages, print or save as PDF.
THE SAME NOTES EVERYWHERE
FortyNote runs on the web and on Windows. The same notes, the same notebooks, the same settings.
